english: Well done. You threw the shot [1-14] yards!
Hey! You can't take that, it's guild property. Take one from the pile.
Alright, thanks!
Alright, thanks!
Hello?
translation: Olá?

english: No you didn't. Get out of my spell!
translation: Não, não começou. Saia do meu contatar NPC!

english: What! I'm no cry-baby, you cry-baby!
translation: O que! Eu não sou tapado, você é tapado!

english: I'm reporting you!
translation: Eu vou te denunciar!

english: Welcome to the Emir's Arena! Are you interested in 1v1 Tournaments? We organise ranked Tournaments here, or alternatively you can organise your own unranked Tournaments.
translation: Bem-vindo à Arena do Emir! Você está interessado em torneios 1v1? Organizamos torneios classificados aqui, ou você pode organizar seus próprios torneios não-classificados.

english: A group of fighters is divided into pairs of opponents, and they all fight their opponent. The winners of those fights proceed to the next round, where they're divided into pairs, and they each fight their new opponent.
translation: Um grupo de lutadores é dividido em pares de oponentes, e todos lutam contra seus oponentes. Os vencedores dessas lutas avançam para a próxima rodada, onde são divididos em pares e cada um luta contra seu novo oponente.

english: The number of surviving fighters is halved each time, until eventually only one person is left standing. They're the winner of the Tournament.
translation: O número de lutadores sobreviventes é reduzido pela metade a cada vez, até que, eventualmente, apenas uma pessoa permaneça em pé. Essa pessoa é a vencedora do torneio.

english: Everyone has a rank. It's meant to indicate how good they are at fighting, compared to other people.
translation: Todos têm uma classificação. Ela serve para indicar o quão bons eles são em lutar, em comparação com outras pessoas.

english: In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Tournament, and send the invitations.
translation: Nas lutas com classificação, os vencedores ganham classificação e os perdedores perdem classificação. A equipe da Arena decidirá quem lutará em cada torneio com classificação e enviará os convites.

english: But if you just want some casual fun, you can have an unranked Tournament, where no-one gains or loses rank. You can organise your own unranked Tournament, and decide for yourself who'll fight in it.
translation: Mas se você quiser apenas se divertir casualmente, pode participar de um torneio sem-classificação, onde ninguém ganha ou perde classificação. Você pode organizar seu próprio torneio sem classificação e decidir por si mesmo quem lutará nele.

english: Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.
translation: Apenas as lutas com classificação oferecem acesso às outras recompensas da Arena.

english: You'll need to sign up to a recruitment group...
translation: Você precisará se inscrever em um grupo de recrutamento...

english: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
translation: Este é o ícone da guia Agrupamento. Nela, você encontrará as opções da Arena PvP.

english: There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Tournaments. Alternatively, you could look for another player's group, for an unranked Tournament.
translation: Lá, você pode clicar em Encontrar para procurar o grupo oficial para torneios classificados. Como alternativa, você pode procurar o grupo de outro jogador para um torneio não classificado.

english: Once you've found a suitable group for you, click Sign up to sign up to it, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Tournament, whenever one begins.
translation: Depois de encontrar um grupo adequado para você, clique em Inscrever-se para se inscrever e você será considerado para um convite para um torneio, sempre que um começar.

english: You can carry on with your adventures while you're waiting for a Tournament to begin, since it may be a while before suitable fighters are available.
translation: Você pode continuar suas aventuras enquanto espera o torneio começar, pois pode demorar um pouco até que lutadores adequados estejam disponíveis.

english: Just use my Recruitment Board here to form your own recruitment group. Once you've got one, wait for other fighters to join it.
translation: Basta usar meu Quadro de Recrutamento aqui para formar seu próprio grupo de recrutamento. Depois de criar um, espere que outros lutadores se juntem a ele.

english: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Once you've formed a recruitment group, you'll be able to control it there, via the PvP Arena options.
translation: Este é o ícone da guia Agrupamento. Depois de formar um grupo de recrutamento, você poderá controlá-lo lá, através das opções da Arena PvP.

english: When you're ready to start, click Start to summon your awaiting fighters. You'll need to be on a PvP Arena world to start your Tournament.
translation: Quando estiver pronto para começar, clique em Iniciar para convocar seus lutadores que estão aguardando. Você precisará estar em um mundo da Arena PvP para iniciar seu torneio.

english: What's a 1v1 Tournament?
translation: O que é um torneio 1v1?

english: Ranked or unranked? What does that mean?
translation: Classificado ou não-classificado? O que significa?

english: How do I get invited into a Tournament?
translation: Como eu posso ser convidado para um Torneio?

english: I want to organise my own Tournament.
translation: Quero organizar meu próprio torneio.

english: Okay, goodbye.
translation: Ok, adeus.

english: I'm okay, thanks.
translation: Estou bem, obrigado.

english: Nope, I say what we do.
Who goes there?
translation: Quem está aí?

english: Arr! A landlubber!
translation: Arr! Um marinheiro de água doce!

english: Begone afore I take my cutlass to ye! I've been charged with guardin' this gate and no noodle-armed landlubbers will make it past me alive!
translation: Vá embora antes que eu use meu gancho em você! Fui encarregado de guardar este portão e nenhum marinheiro de água doce com braços fracos passará por mim vivo!

english: Ye cheeky begger! I was wavin' my finger at ye!
translation: Seu pedinte atrevido! Eu estava acenando com o dedo para você!

english: Arrr... just 'cos me body happens to be 50% wood does not mean I'm heartless.
translation: Arrr... só porque meu corpo é 50% madeira, não significa que eu não tenha coração.

english: I got a bag of 'em here. Wanna see?
translation: Tenho um saco cheio deles aqui. Quer ver?

english: That be a tale so heart-wrenchin' that it has so far wrenched the hearts from over a dozen sturdier men than thee!
translation: É uma história tão comovente que já partiu o coração de mais de uma dúzia de homens mais fortes do que você!

english: A tale of such woe that none but the stoniest hearts can hear it without sheddin' a single, poignant tear...
translation: Uma história tão triste que só os corações mais duros conseguem ouvir sem derramar uma única lágrima comovente...

english: And I'll never tell ye, not even if ye wore an item, such as a ring, with powers of mind control!
translation: E eu nunca vou contar para você, nem mesmo se você usasse um item, como um anel, com poderes de controle mental!

english: Hmmmm...well alright...
translation: Hmmmm... bem, tudo bem...

english: Wait, no!
translation: Espere, não vai me enganar não!

english: Get goin' landlubber before I take my splintery foot to yer behind!
translation: Vá embora, marinheiro de água doce, antes que eu dê um chute no seu traseiro com meu pé de madeira cheio de farpas!

english: Well ye seem like a [lad/lass] that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: Bem, você parece ser um [rapaz/moça] capaz de lidar emocionalmente com tal história... então eu vou lhe contar...

english: Well, it all starts with this albatross...
translation: Bem, tudo começa com este albatroz...

english: Wait, never mind, I'll skip forward a bit.
translation: Espere, esqueça, vou pular um pouco adiante.

english: I have to [lad/lass], Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: Eu tenho que adiantar [rapaz/moça], o capitão Donnie vai me esfolar vivo se eu contar.

english: But anyway, I got recruited to the zombie pirates along with the rest of the crew in an unspecified incident involvin this albatross.
translation: Mas enfim, eu fui recrutado pelos piratas zumbis junto com o resto da tripulação em um incidente não especificado envolvendo esse albatroz.

english: We was sailin' along happily, and I was partakin' of a little 'rum' in the crows nest.
translation: Estávamos navegando alegremente, e eu estava tomando um pouco de rum no ninho do corvo.

english: Well, we hit either a really rough wave or some rocks.
translation: Bem, batemos em uma onda muito forte ou em algumas rochas.

english: Twas kind of hard for me to tell which, as I was well out of it by then!
translation: Era difícil para mim dizer qual das duas, pois eu já estava bem fora de mim naquele momento!

english: Regardless I toppled from the crows nest into the water.
translation: De qualquer forma, eu caí do ninho do corvo na água.

english: No [lad/lass]!
translation: Não [cara/menina]!

english: What happened next was that I discovered a new, previously uncharted reef of hard, spiky coral.
translation: O que aconteceu a seguir foi que descobri um novo recife de corais duros e pontiagudos, anteriormente desconhecido.

english: I made a mental note of its location, and to this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as Lukes Reef.
translation: Anotei mentalmente sua localização e, até hoje, ele ainda está marcado nos mapas da nossa frota como Recife de Luke.

english: I managed to grab a hold of our ship, the Inebriated, as it passed overhead.
translation: Consegui me agarrar ao nosso navio, o Inebriável, quando ele passou por cima de mim.

english: And then I discovered another, taller, spikier reef of even sharper and more painful coral.
translation: E então descobri outro recife, mais alto e mais pontiagudo, com corais ainda mais afiados e dolorosos.

english: To this day it is still marked on our fleet's charts as The Other 50% Reef.
translation: Até hoje, ele ainda está marcado nos mapas da nossa frota como O Outro Recife 50%.

english: It gets worse...
translation: E fica pior...

english: When they hauled what was left of me on deck, they dropped me onto the floor while they decided what to do with me.
translation: Quando eles puxaram o que restava de mim para o convés, me jogaram no chão enquanto decidiam o que fazer comigo.

english: Bear in mind this would be on a ghost ship, the planks of which sweat a thick mixture of stagnant water...and pure salt crystals.
translation: Lembre-se de que isso aconteceu em um navio fantasma, cujas tábuas exalam uma mistura espessa de água estagnada... e cristais de sal puro.

english: But on the good side, all my thrashin' and pained squealin' settled the matter in the Captain's mind, and he had the shipwright carve me half a body out of his Witchwood Planks.
translation: Mas, pelo lado bom, toda a minha agitação e gritos de dor resolveram a questão na mente do capitão, e ele mandou o carpinteiro naval esculpir metade do meu corpo com tábuas de madeira de bruxa.

english: Tis a special, magical wood from a now extinct tree.
translation: É uma madeira especial e mágica de uma árvore agora extinta.

english: Once they nailed it all in place the stuff moves like it is part of me body.
translation: Depois que eles pregaram tudo no lugar, o material se move como se fosse parte do meu corpo.

english: The stuff will also grow back if it breaks, which is dead handy!
translation: O material também cresce de novo se quebrar, o que é muito útil!

english: Arr! That it be!
translation: Arr! É mesmo!

english: So, that be the tale of how I managed to lose precisely 50% of my body.
translation: Então, essa é a história de como eu consegui perder exatamente 50% do meu corpo.

english: What kind of a question is that?
translation: Que tipo de pergunta é essa?

english: Ye've got that right!
translation: É o que eu ia dizer!

english: Don't make me angry! Ye'll not like me when I'm angry!
translation: Não me deixe com raiva! Você não vai gostar de mim quando estou com raiva!

english: Let that be a lesson to ye!
translation: Que isso sirva de lição para você!

english: Ye expect me to talk?
translation: Você espera que eu fale?

english: Hah! I'm one step ahead of ye!
translation: Hah! Estou um passo à sua frente!

english: I can't tell ye [lad/lass].
translation: Não posso te contar, [rapaz/moça].

english: The Cap'n would have me whittled down to toothpicks if I did.
translation: O capitão me transformaria em palitos de dente da Gina, se eu contasse.

english: No. Just...no.
translation: Não. Simplesmente... não.

english: Look, [lad/lass] I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: Olha, [rapaz/moça], não vou te contar nada! Então saia daqui enquanto ainda pode!

english: Arr! Tryin' ter get away eh? Well ye'll never sneak past me, I'm the best lookout this crew has ever seen!
translation: Arr! Tentando fugir, hein? Bem, você nunca vai passar por mim, sou o melhor vigia que esta tripulação já teve!

english: Where?
translation: Onde?

english: Hey! What are you doing out there?
translation: Ei! O que você está fazendo aí fora?

english: Well Cap'n Donnie said no livin' landlubbers were allowed out of the compound.
translation: Bem, o Capitão Donnie disse que nenhum marinheiro de primeira viagem poderia sair do complexo.

english: So get yerself back in here, or yer for it!
translation: Então volte para cá, ou você vai se dar mal!

english: What happened to you?
translation: O que aconteceu com você?

english: How flammable are you?
translation: O quão inflamável você é?

english: So what is going on here anyway?
translation: Então, o que está acontecendo aqui afinal?

english: Hi. How can I help?
translation: Oi. Como posso ajudar?

english: Sorry, I'm not on duty.
translation: Desculpe, eu não estou trabalhando agora.

english: PLEASE DON'T KILL ME!
translation: POR FAVOR NÃO ME MATE!

english: No way, I'm out of here just as soon as I've packed up my stuff!
translation: De forma alguma, eu vou dar o fora daqui assim que acabar de arrumar minhas coisas.

english: You look healthy to me!
translation: Você parece saudável para mim!

english: Of course!
translation: É claro!

english: Yes I do. Thankfully we can cope with almost anything. Jaraah really is a wonderful surgeon, his methods are a little unorthodox but he gets the job done.
translation: Sim. Ainda bem que podemos lidar com quase tudo. O Jaraah é um cirurgião maravilhoso, seus métodos são... diferentes. Mas ele faz o trabalho bem feito.

english: I shouldn't tell you this but his nickname is 'The Butcher'.
translation: Eu não deveria te dizer, mas o apelido dele é "O Açougueiro".

english: I work here, so yes!
translation: Eu trabalho aqui, então sim!

english: You're silly!
translation: Você é curioso!

english: Can you heal me?
translation: Você pode me curar?

english: Do you see a lot of injured fighters?
translation: Você vê muitos combatentes machucados?

english: Do you come here often?
translation: Você vem aqui com frequência?

english: Greetings traveller.
translation: Saudações, viajante.

english: Ok.
translation: Tudo bem.

english: Abbot Langley places his hands on your head. You feel a little better.
translation: O Abade Langley coloca as mãos em sua testa. Você se sente um pouco melhor.

english: We like it that way actually! We get disturbed less. We still get rather a large amount of travellers looking for sanctuary and healing here as it is!
translation: Na verdade nós o preferimos assim! Somos menos incomodados. Ainda assim, recebemos viajantes buscando rezar no santuário e receber uma cura.

english: I'm sorry but only members of our order are allowed in the second level of the monastery.
translation: Sinto muito, somente membros da nossa ordem podem subir ao andar de cima do Monastério.

english: No. I am sorry, but I feel you are not devout enough.
translation: Não. Lamento, mas eu sinto que você não tem devoção suficiente.

english: You need a prayer level of 31 to join the order.
translation: Você precisa de nível 31 em Oração para juntar-se à Ordem.

english: Ok, I see you are someone suitable for our order. You may join.
translation: Ok, vejo que você é alguém adequado para nossa Ordem. Você pode se juntar a nós.

english: Oh, sorry.
translation: Ah, me desculpe.

english: I might be able to... What did you have in mind?
translation: Talvez eu seja capaz... O que você tem em mente?

english: I think I shoud be able to manage that. However in doing so, I'm afraid I'll have to destroy the blessed shield itself. You'll only get the sigil back.
translation: Acho que eu consigo fazer isso. Todavia, receio que terei que destruir o escudo abençoado por inteiro. Você receberá apenas o selo de volta.

english: I can go ahead and break down all of the shields in your inventory now if you'd like?.
translation: Se me permitir, eu posso destruir todos os escudos que você tem na mochila?

english: Abbot Langley carefully breaks each shield, leaving the sigils perfectly intact.
translation: O Abade Langley cuidadosamente quebra escudo por escudo, deixando os selos perfeitamente intactos.

english: Only members of our order can go up there.
translation: Somente membros da nossa ordem podem subir aí.

english: Ah, I was told to expect you, please take this as thanks!
translation: Ah, me disseram que você apareceria, por favor pegue isso como agradecimento!

english: Abbot Langley quickly takes the soft clay, leather boots and bowl of hot water in exchange for a mysterious helmet.
translation: O Abade Langley pega rapidamente a sua argila macia, botas de couro e a tigela de água quente em troca de um elmo misterioso.

english: Congratulations, traveller!
translation: Parabéns, viajante!

english: Abbot Langley has given you another clue scroll!
translation: O Abade Langley lhe deu outro pergaminho de dicas!

english: Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
translation: Ei, eu tenho algo para você, mas infelizmente você não tem nenhum espaço livre para recebê-lo!

english: Here you go.
translation: Aqui está.

english: You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
translation: Você recebe uma parte rasgada de pergaminho de dicas.

english: I must say, I despise the equipment you have chosen to wear.
translation: Eu me sinto obrigado a dizer, o equipamento que você está usando é desprezível.

english: Can you heal me? I'm injured.
translation: Você pode me curar? Estou machucado.

english: Isn't this place built a bit out of the way?
translation: Este lugar não foi construído um pouco fora de mão?

english: How do I get further into the monastery?
translation: Como eu acesso o andar de cima do Monastério?

english: Well can I join your order?
translation: Bem, posso juntar-me à sua Ordem?

english: Can you help with spirit shields?
translation: Você pode me ajudar com escudos espirituais?

english: Yes.
translation: Sim.

english: No.
translation: Não.

english: Gosh, you are very kind to bring a message to my remote monastery!
translation: Minha Nossa, é muita gentileza sua trazer uma mensagem até mim, em meu monastério isolado.

english: I'd give you a reward, but you don't seem to have any space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: Eu lhe daria uma recompensa, mas parece que você não tem nenhum espaço livre na mochila. Volte quando tiver.

english: I grow a few herbs in my little cabbage patch; please take some as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: Eu cultivo algumas plantas em meu canteiro de repolhos; por favor, pegue alguns e tenha a minha gratidão.

english: Allow me to bestow on you Saradomin's blessings...
translation: Permita-me conceder-lhe as bençãos de Saradomin...

english: Herbs
translation: Ervas

english: Coins
translation: Moedas

english: Runes
translation: Runas

english: Seeds
translation: Sementes

english: Prayer experience
translation: XP em Oração

english: Grr ... Get out of my way...
translation: Grr... Sai do meu caminho...

english: What can I help you with, dear?
translation: No que posso te ajudar, querido?

english: I'm Abigaila, from Morytania. It's a terrible place, run by the vampyres. They visit the towns and collect everyone's blood for food!
translation: Sou Abigaila, de Moritânia. É um lugar terrível, governado por Vampiros. Eles vêm às nossas cidades chupar nosso sangue para se alimentarem!

english: I tried for years to escape, with my son, Suro, to make a better life for ourselves in Misthalin. I scraped together enough money to bribe a boatman to get us out.
translation: Eu tentei escapar por anos, com meu filho, Suro, para buscar uma vida melhor em Misthalin. Eu consegui juntar uns trocados o suficientes para subornar um barqueiro a nos tirar de lá.

english: The journey was tough. Some men in pink hoods attacked our boat, shouting at us to go back where we belonged, and to keep out of their country. In the struggle, the boat overturned.
translation: A viagem foi difícil. Alguns homens de capuzes rosas atacaram nosso barco, gritando para voltarmos de onde viemos, e ficarmos longe do país deles. Na confusão, o nosso barco virou.

english: It was dark, and I couldn't find Suro in the water. I swam as deep as I could, until my lungs screamed, but I couldn't find him. He wasn't good at swimming.
translation: Estava escuro, e eu não conseguia achar meu Suro na água. Eu mergulhei mais fundo que meus pulmões permitiram, mas não o encontrei. Ele nunca nadou bem.

english: Eventually I got myself to the shore. The sun was rising, and I found Suro there. On the shore, where the water had dumped his... body.
translation: Eventualmente, acordei na areia da costa. O sol estava nascendo, e me deparei com o corpo do Suro... Trazido pelas águas comigo.

english: *sob*
translation: *choro*

english: I've done alright in Misthalin, I guess. I know a bit of magic, and the local gentry pay me well for my scrying skills. I'm good at turning a profit on Grand Exchange trades too.
translation: Eu tenho vivido bem em Misthalin, apesar de tudo. Sei um pouco de mágica, e os locais me pagam bem para prestar serviços de vidência a eles. Também tenho conseguido lucrar com vendas no Mercado Geral.

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room in Lumbridge, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: Enfim, hoje tenho alugado um quarto em Lumbridge, e posso comprar comida. Não estou sendo um fardo para ninguém, e não há mais vampiros no meu cangote.

english: I am free!
translation: Sou uma mulher livre!

english: But I haven't forgotten my people in the east. There's one vampyre there who runs a place she calls the Theatre of Blood, challenging humans to face monsters in her arena.
translation: Mas não esqueci de meu povo do leste. Tem uma vampira lá que gere um lugar chamado Theatre of Blood, desafiando humanos a enfrentar monstros em sua arena.

english: My husband went there, trying to win freedom from the blood-gatherers by surviving her arena, but he never returned. No-one does.
translation: Meu marido foi até lá, tentando ganhar sua liberdade dos sugadores-de-sangue ao lutar na arena. Mas ele nunca retornou. Ninguém consegue retornar.

english: So now I pass my spare time scrying on the Theatre of Blood, watching other adventurers there. You can have a look, if you like.
translation: Então hoje em dia eu passo meu tempo livre adivinhando aventureiros no Theatre of Blood. Você pode olhar, se quiser.

english: I'm afraid I can't let you use my scrying ball now, dear. Clear out everything you're carrying, and make sure you're not sick or poisoned.
translation: Receio que não posso permitir, querido. Livre-se de tudo que estiver carregando, e garanta que você não está doente ou envenenado.

english: Who are you and what are you doing?
translation: Quem é você e o que está fazendo?

english: I'd like to look in your scrying ball.
translation: Eu gostaria de olhar na sua esfera de adivinhação.

english: Observe a specific party
translation: Observar um grupo específico

english: Observe recent party
translation: Observar o grupo mais recente

english: Cancel
translation: Cancelar

english: I'll leave you be.
translation: Te deixarei em paz.

english: Help! Help!
translation: Socorro! Socorro!

english: We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: Nós fomos convidados para uma festa em uma casa, numa ilha não tão longe... Tinha algo ruim no ar, mas fomos mesmo assim...

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: A mansão parecia bem assustadora, mas tudo estava indo bem, estávamos nos divertindo...

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
translation: ...e foi aí que fomos atacados...

english: Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: Hewey conseguiu nos dar tempo suficiente para encontrar um barco antigo.

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: Você tem que fazer algumam coisa... eles não podem se livrar dessa!

english: That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: O assassino ainda está à solta lá, você tem que levá-lo à justiça.

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: O barco que usamos para fugir está bem ali, você pode usá-lo para navegar até a ilha.

english: Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.
translation: Por favor, você precisa garantir que eles não escapem da justiça! Você pode usar o barco ali para navegar até a ilha de que nós fugimos.

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: O jogador tira a máscara do assassino, revelando o rosto de Abigale.

english: You just don't get it do you?
translation: Você ainda não entendeu, não é?

english: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: Tão presunçoso. Tão acostumado a ser tudo sobre você. Sobre você salvar o dia.

english: Well I'm sick of it!
translation: Bem, me cansei disso!

english: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: Aventureiros! Vocês são todos iguais. Tudo sempre tem que girar em torno de vocês.

english: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: Claro que você não entende! Seu ego é grande demais para entender!

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: Acredite ou não... Eu costumava ser como você.

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: Há uma dama em perigo? Eu ajudo a salvá-la. Para ter meu momento. Para eu ser uma herói, pelo menos uma vez.

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: Mas VOCÊ! Você e os outros malditos aventureiros! Sempre que eu vou ajudar, já é tarde. Crise resolvida. Desastre evitado. Recompensa reivindicada. Em todos os momentos você e os outros roubam o meu momento!

english: But not this time!
translation: Mas não dessa vez!

english: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: Dessa vez, tudo girará ao meu redor. Eu sou a estrela do show! EU EU EU EU EU!

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: Ah, mas sempre há um próximo.

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: Outro assassino sai do armário perto da porta.

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: É claro. Todo show que se preze tem um ator coadjuvante. Agora, tive sua máscara querido. Fique comigo, você mereceu.

english: The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: O assassino tira sua própria máscara, revelando o rosto de Hewey.

english: Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: Talvez não, mas eu também não merecia ser jogada às sombras quando eu mereço ser a estrela maior!

english: And now I have my starring role!
translation: E agora eu tenho um momento para chamar de meu!

english: Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: Guilenor lembrará para sempre o que aconteceu nesta noite e o que eu fiz.

english: Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: Silêncio Hewey! Esse é o meu momento!

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: Pare de arruinar as coisas Hewey! Eu me dediquei muito para isso e não permitirei que você roube o meu momento de mim!

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: Nós nunca fomos iguais! Como você ousa se comparar a mim!?

english: Abigale stabs Hewey.
translation: Abigale esfaqueia Hewey.

english: Hewey dies.
translation: Hewey morre.

english: No....no...what have I done!?
translation: Não....não...o que eu fiz!?

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: Não era pra acabar assim...mas você não estava me deixando brilhar no meu momento... POR QUE HEWEY POR QUE? Eu te amava...

english: The player stabs Abigale.
translation: O jogador esfaqueia Abigale.

english: You'll never escape me!
translation: Você nunca vai escapar de mim!

english: In the background, Mandy gets up.
translation: No background, Mandy acorda.

english: You dare try and ruin my moment!
translation: Você ousa tentar arruinar o meu momento!

english: Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: Mandy anda em direção à mesa, que contém uma Espada Divina de Bandos.

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
translation: Hewey morreu por sua causa!

english: Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: Mandy pega a Espada Divina de Bandos e entra no closet.

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
translation: Agora chegou sua hora de juntar-se à ele!

english: Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
translation: Mandy sai do closet atrás de Abigale.

english: Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.

english: I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
translation: Eu sou o Tutor da Conta. Estou aqui para lhe dizer sobre sua conta.

english: Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
translation: Seu personagem É sua conta! É o que você está usando agora para jogar neste instante. Todos aqui têm uma, alguns têm várias contas!

english: There’s various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let’s take a look at it now.
translation: Existem várias coisas que você pode fazer com sua conta, e é aí que entra o menu Gerenciamento da Conta. Vamos dar uma olhada.

english: As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: Como você pode ver, há algumas coisas que você pode fazer com sua conta.

english: First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
translation: Primeiro, existe a assinatura. Todas as contas são gratuitas por padrão, mas se desejar, pode assinar para desbloquear os mundos de membro. Nestes mundos, você tem acesso a mais habilidades, áreas, missões e mais!

english: A world is what you play the game on. Each world can hold up to 2000 players and they are split into two main types, free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the world switcher in the logout menu.
translation: Um mundo é onde você joga o jogo. Cada mundo suporta até 2000 jogadores e eles são distintos em duas categorias: Grátis e Membros. Você pode trocar de mundo no menu de seleção de mundos.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members’ world and enjoy all of the benefits, you’ll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: Neste momento você está em um mundo grátis. Se quiser trocar para um mundo de membros e aproveitar todos os benefícios, você precisa comprar a assinatura. Pode fazer isso no botão Assine Agora, no menu Gerenciamento da Conta.

english: You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
translation: Neste momento você está em um mundo de membros, então você tem acesso à todos os benefícios que membros têm. Aproveite!

english: Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
translation: Bonds são outra coisa que você conhecer. Você pode comprar bonds pela loja, no menu Gerenciamento da Conta. Uma vez que tiver algumas bonds, pode convertê-las em assinatura!

english: Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
translation: Ao contrário da assinatura, Bonds podem ser negociadas com outros jogadores. Você pode comprar uma Bond e então vender para outro jogador para conseguir dinheiro. Alternativamente, você pode usar o seu dinheiro pra comprar uma Bond de outro jogador.

english: Exactly!
translation: Exatamente!

english: Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you’ll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: A seguir, você tem a inbox e "mudar de nome". A inbox é onde você vai receber informações importantes relacionadas à sua conta e ao jogo. Tenha certeza de olhar lá.

english: The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
translation: O alternador de nome permite que você mude seu nome no jogo caso não esteja satisfeito com o atual. Saiba que isso só está disponível para membros.

english: Finally, the bottom of the menu has some links which you might find useful. Make sure you check them out at some point.
translation: Finalmente, a parte de baixo do menu possui alguns links que você pode achar úteis. Dê uma olhada quando precisar.

english: Only this. Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. You have many tools at your disposal to help out with this such as bank pins and authenticators.
translation: Só mais isso. A sua conta é muito valiosa e é importante que você cuide dela. Você possui várias ferramentas que pode usar para isso, como senhas de banco e autenticadores.

english: You’ll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the useful links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: Você encontrará mais informações sobre segurança da conta no site de Suporte. Use a seção de botões no menu Links Úteis, Gerenciamento da Conta para ir até lá.

english: Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
translation: De qualquer forma, isso é tudo que tenho a dizer sobre contas. Fale comigo de novo para ser lembrado, ou prossiga para o próximo tutor.

english: Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
translation: Olá. Gostaria de falar sobre sua conta novamente?

english: Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
translation: Excelente. Bem, tem algumas coisas que você pode fazer com sua conta.

english: You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
translation: Neste momento você está em um mundo grátis. Se quiser trocar para um mundo de membros e aproveitar todos os benefícios, você precisa comprar a assinatura. Pode fazer isso no botão Assine Agora, no menu Gerenciamento da Conta.

english: Next up, you have your inbox. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
Finally, you have your display name. Every account has a unique display name. If you don't like your current one, you can change it with the name changer.
You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the useful links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
Anyway, that's everything. I hope that has helped you out.
Yes!

A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
Hey there adventurer. I am Gordon, the Account security tutor. I can help you with anything account security related, would you like to know anything?
There are many ways you can strengthen your account security, which would you like to hear more about?
Your password is the first line of defence in keeping your account secure.
When choosing a password, make sure to keep it unique. You can do this by using a mix of letters and numbers. You could even use numbers in the middle of your password.
For extra security, you should make sure you use a different password for your account and email.
You should keep your password safe and tell no one. Not even your friends or family.
Is there anything else you would like to know?
Make sure you use a separate password for your email account. This will help boost your security and make it less likely for hijackers to steal your account.
You should also enable two-step authentication on your email account, if your email supports it.
This could be done through an authenticator app supplied by your email provider, or it could be done using your mobile phone number.
The type of authenticator changes based on provider, but when active, hijackers will find it hard to access your account. Also, if you get any backup codes, keep them safe.
The RuneScape authenticator will provide your account with another layer of security against hijackers who might want to steal your account.
As well as requiring a password to enter your account, you will also need a randomly generated number from the authenticator app to login.
You can enable the authenticator by checking your account page on the official RuneScape website.
If you like, I can take you to a useful web page about the RuneScape authenticator.
If someone does get into your account, you should make sure your bank is secure.
To keep your bank secure, you should make sure to set a bank pin. A bank pin is a 4 digit code you will need to put in to access your bank.
To setup a bank pin you will need to visit any bank where you can find a banker. You should then speak to the banker and ask them about setting up a bank pin.
After the bank pin has been set, you will need to wait a few days for the pin to take effect.
Good on you [lad/lass]! Great work.
The Stronghold of Security can be found in the Barbarian Village, west of Varrock.
Here you will be tested on your knowledge of account security. You will need to make your way to the bottom floor while answering question on account security and fighting monsters.
Be aware, the deeper into the stronghold you go, the tougher the monster will be. So make sure you bring your best equipment and some food.
If you do manage to make it to the end of each floor, you will be able to loot the chest for some loot. But only once per floor.
If you decide to kill the monsters, you might find they drop some skull sceptre pieces.
Sure thing, here you go.

Use it well.

He spends all his time giving out security books when he could tell you about security instead.
Well yes, but at least I tell you about account security as well.
Come back any time you need any more information on account security.

Tell me about the authenticator.

No thanks.

Oh, my sister, she lives in Keldagrim-East. Has a little stall on the other side of the Kelda.
If she only worked a little harder, like me, she wouldn't have to live in the sewers of the city. Shame really.
Keldagrim-East, such a ghastly place. Not civil, polite and clean like we are in the West.
Quests? Why would I have any quests?
No, not right now... maybe I'll have something for you to do later, but nothing at the moment.
Who makes these clothes then?
I still want to buy your clothes.
So do you have any quests for me?
I cannot speak to you outerlander! Talk to Brundt, the Chieftain!
You stay away from me outerlander!
They are too suspicious of you for you to get close enough to steal from them.
Hello again [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
My door is always open should you ever need my help [Fremennik name].
[Fremennik name]... It has been too long since last we met!
Welcome back [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
My apologies [brother/sister] [Fremennik name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
How are you [Fremennik name]? I hope all fares well with you this day!
All is well with me also!
Hello to you, too!
Hello. Did you want something [Fremennik name]?
Well... okay then!
Always good to see you [brother/sister] [Fremennik name].
You shame us, [Fremennik name]!
How can you steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
You have betrayed your heritage, [Fremennik name]!
Why would you try to steal from me, [Fremennik name]?
Chieftain Brundt!
Chieftain Brundt! I’m here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We’ve heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
[Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all our problems!

You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we’ve had nothing but trouble! And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!
Do not use the name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
Arrr, matey!
Redbeard Frank ye say? He be outside. Says he likes the feel of the wind on his cheeks.
Aye, I am. I canna walk, ye see.
Arrr, I 'ave only the one leg! I lost its twin when my last ship went down.
Nay, young [laddie/lassie], this be a false leg. For years I had me a sturdy wooden peg-leg, but now I wear this dainty little feller.
Yon peg-leg kept getting stuck in the floorboards.
Perhaps a [bright young laddie/bonnie young lassie] like yerself would like to help me? I be needing another ship to go a-hunting my enemy.
Arrr! That ship be known to me, and a fine lass she is.
So would ye be kind enough to let me take her out to sea?
Nay, I have nary a penny to my name. All my worldly goods went down with me old ship.
Arrr! Would ye be so kind?
Arrr.
Nothin' at the moment, but then again the Customs Agents are on the warpath right now.
Oi matey, leave my beer alone!
translation: Aí cara, deixa minha cerveja em paz!

english: Oi matey, no casting spells on my beer!
translation: Ô meu bom, nada de lançar feitiços no meu chop!

english: I'm looking for Redbeard Frank.
translation: Estou procurando o Frank Barbarruiva.

english: Arrr!
translation: Arrr!

english: Are you going to sit there all day?
translation: Você vai ficar sentado aí o dia todo?

english: Do you want to trade?
translation: Você quer negociar?

english: You dare disturb my rest!
translation: Como ousa perturbar o meu sono!

english: You dare steal from us!
Gratias tibi ago!
Hello. Do you wish me to exchange banknotes for you? I charge only 5 coins for each banknote.
Hand me the banknotes you wish me to exchange.
I am Aisles. I can exchange banknotes for real items. Do you want any banknotes converted?
I exchange banknotes for real items. That's not a banknote.
I charge 5 coins for exchanging each banknote.
Yes please.
Who are you?
No thanks.
Exchange [item name]: 5 coins
Exchange All: [number of banknotes x 5] coins
Cancel
Greetings, fellow warrior. I am Ajjat, former black knight and now training officer here in the warrior guild.

Skillcapes, also known as Capes of Accomplishment, are reserved for the elite of the elite. Only a person who has truly mastered a skill can buy one, and even then a skillcape can only be bought from one who is
recognised as the highest skilled in the land at any particular skill.
I have the privilege of being the person that controls access to the Skillcape of Attack, which Kamfreena will recognize and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
Indeed I was, however their... methods... did not match with my ideals.. so I left. Harrallak, recognising my talent as a warrior, took me in and offered me a job here.

Ahh yes, the dummies. Another ingenious invention of the noble Dwarf Gamfred. They're mechanical you see and pop up out of the floor. You have to hit them with the correct attack mode before they disappear again.
There are two different ways. One indication is their colour, the other is the pose and weapons they are holding, for instance, the one holding daggers you will need to hit with a piercing attack.
In the room you will find a poster on the wall which can help you recognise each different dummy.
Indeed, you may find that you need several weapons to be successful 100% of the time, but keep trying. The weapons shop upstairs may help you there.
Of course! Here you go, you've earned [amount] tokens!
I'm afraid you have not earned any tokens yet. Try some of the activities around the guild to earn some.
Farewell warrior. Stay away from the dark side.
Ah, but I can see you are already a master in the fine art of attacking, perhaps you have come to me to purchase a Cape of Attack, and thus join the elite few who have mastered this exacting skill?
When wearing this cape, Kamfreena will recognize your ability and allow you to access her Cyclopes without the need for guild tokens.
Most certainly; unfortunately being such a prestigious item, they are appropriately expensive. I'm afraid I must ask you for the princely sum of 99000 gold!
Not at all; there are many other adventurers who would love the opportunity to purchase such a prestigious item! You can find me here if you change your mind.
Well come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
Most certainly, and free of charge!
Ajjat hands you another hood for your skillcape.
Can you tell me about skillcapes, please?
Black Knight? Why are you here?
What's the Dummy Room all about?
May I claim my tokens please?
Bye!
May I buy a Skillcape of Attack, please?
99000 gold! Are you mad?
I would gladly pay such a paltry sum for a splendid cape.
Skillcape
Hood
And Ak-Haranu thanks you for kind gift of longbow.
May shadows be your grave!
All will be ashes!
Resisting only delays the inevitable!
All will be ashes.
Fight back, coward.
From one prison, to another.
Why, helloooo!
Well this is grand darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
My dear, I'm a camel, how should I know?
I think I am somewhat confused.
May one ask how you contacted me?
Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new-fangled gadgets!
Hello Effendi!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads.
I am Al Shabim Effendi! I am the leader of the Bedabin peoples!
Good day Effendi!
Well, we are all very busy most of the time, tending to the pineapples. They are grown in a secret location, to stop thieves from raiding our most precious prize.
This is the home of the Bedabin. We're a peaceful tribe of desert dwellers. Some idiots call us 'Tenti's', a childish name borne of ignorance.
We're renowned for surviving in the harshest desert climate. We also grow the 'Bedabin ambrosia.'... A pineapple of such delicious sumptiousness that it defies description.
Take a look around our camp if you like!
I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads. Now... what can I do for you?
Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
Captain Siad at the mining camp is holding some secret information. It is very important to us and we would like you to get it for us. It gives details of an interesting, yet ancient weapon.

We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
That's great Effendi!
Here is a copy of the key that should give you access to the chest.
Al Shabim gives you a key.
Bring us back the plans inside the chest, they should be sealed. All haste to you Effendi!
Very well Effendi!
What is this place?
Who are you?
How are things going Effendi?
How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
Al Shabim gives you another key.
Very well, good day Effendi!
Aha! I see you have the plans. This is great! However, these plans do indeed look very technical. My people have further need of your skills.
If you can help us to manufacture this item, we will share its secret with you. Does this deal interest you effendi?
Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze, 10 feathers and a hammer. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze and 10 feathers. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers and a hammer before we can continue.
Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze and a hammer before we can continue.
Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers before we can continue.
Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze before we can continue.
Great, I can see that you have some feathers and a bar of Bronze, but you just need a hammer now.
Great, I can see that you have some feathers, a bar of Bronze and a hammer. Are you still willing to help make the weapon?
Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this... There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
You have the plans and all the items needed. You should be able to complete the item on your own. Please bring me the item when it is finished.
As you wish Effendi!
Come back if you change your mind!
Wonderful, I see you have made the new weapon!
You show Al Shabim the prototype dart.
This is truly fantastic Effendi!
But we will need the technical plans from you Effendi. If we are going to perfect this weapon.
We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
You hand over the technical plans for the weapon.
We are forever grateful for this gift. My advisors have discovered some secrets which we will share with you.
Al Shabim's advisors show you some advanced techniques for making the new weapon.
Please accept this selection of six bronze throwing darts as a token of our appreciation.
You receive six bronze throwing darts from Al Shabim.
I'll take that key off your hands as well effendi! Many thanks!
*** Dart Construction *** Congratulations! You can now construct darts.
Oh, and here is your pineapple!
You receive a tasty looking pineapple from Al Shabim.
Many thanks with your help previously Effendi!
I am looking for a pineapple.
Here is another pineapple, try not to lose this one.
Okay thanks!
What is there to do around here?
Okay Thanks!
Yes, I'm interested.
Not at the moment.
I've lost the key!
Goodbye!
Yes, I'm very interested.
Yes, I'm kind of curious.
No, sorry.
The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
Are you serious?
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
I hope that's what you wanted!
Sorry, were you saying something to me?
Never mind, it is unimportant when I have such important matters weighing on my soul.
Well, you see, there is a camel called Elly. A beautiful, wondrous camel, with hide like spun gold and teeth that shine like an oasis.
I've written many poems describing her beauty. Would you like to hear one?
Shall I compare thee to a desert's day? Thou art drier and more rough-skinned.
Rough sandstorms shake the cactuses away And summer's heat defers to autumn wind.
Sometimes too hot the eye of heaven shines, With Guthix' gold complexion often dimmed;
And every fair from fair sometime declines, By chance or desert's changing course untrimmed...
But I've only got six lines left!
Very well. Come back and talk to me if you want to hear more.
Oh, it's you again. Have you come back to listen to my poems?
That's so kind of you. Which one would you like to hear?
Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
That's my favourite poem. Ahem...
But thine eternal desert shall not fade Nor lose possession of that sand thou owest;
Nor Zamorak brag thou art in his shades, When in eternal lines to sand thou growest,
So long as camels breathe or eyes can see, So long lives this, and this gives life to thee.
Ah, Elly, how beautiful you are.
She's never heard them.
I suspect she loves another - Ollie, another camel who roams with her to the north.
So I shall stay here and compose poems for her.
She seems happy enough as she is, and I have my poems to comfort me.
If you want to hear my poems once more, please come back again.
I wrote this poem when I went to the oasis to nibble at a tree, then discovered I'd left nothing for Elly to nibble. I was distraught.
This Is Just To Say
I have nibbled the cacti that were by the oasis,
and which you were probably saving for lunch.
Forgive me, they were delicious, so crunchy and so cold.
I wonder if she's forgiven me for eating her snack.
Ah, well. I shall return to writing poems to Elly's beauty.
Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
I'd love to!
Listen to 'Shall I compare thee to a desert's day'.
Why not tell her how you feel?
Well, best of luck with that.
Listen to 'This Is Just To Say'.
No, thank you.
I might - which patch were you thinking of?

english: You don't have any seeds planted in that patch. Plant some and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: Não tem nenhuma semente germinando naquele canteiro. Plante alguma coisa lá e talvez eu concorde em cuidar dele.

english: That patch is diseased - you should cure it before asking me to be responsible for it!
translation: Aquele canteiro está doente - você deve curá-lo antes de me pedir para protegê-lo!

english: That patch is dead - it's too late for me to do anything about it now.
translation: Aquele canteiro está morto - é tarde demais para eu fazer alguma coisa.

english: That patch is already fully grown! I don't know what you want me to do with it!
translation: Aquele canteiro já está totalmente crescido! Eu não sei o que você quer que eu faça com ele!

english: I'm already looking after that patch for you.
translation: Eu já estou cuidando daquele canteiro para você.

english: If you like, but I want [payment] for that.
translation: Se você quiser, mas eu quero [payment] para isso.

english: Well, I'm not wasting my time for free.
translation: Bem, eu não vou trabalhar de graça.

english: That'll do nicely, [sir/madam]. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: Isso vai servir, [senhor/madame]. Deixe-os comigo - Irei garantir que aquela plantação cresça para você.

english: Poison ivy bushes don't get diseased, so you needn't worry about having it protected.
translation: Arbustos de hera venenosa não ficam doentes, então você não precisa esquentar a cabeça com proteção.

english: You can put up to ten potatoes, cabbages or onions in vegetable sacks, although you can't have a mix in the same sack.
translation: Você pode colocar até dez batatas, repolhos ou cebolas em sacos de vegetais. Mas não pode misturar colheitas diferentes no mesmo saco.

english: You can put up to five tomatoes, strawberries, apples, bananas or oranges into a fruit basket, although you can't have a mix in the same basket.
translation: Você pode colocar até cinco tomates, morangos, maçãs, bananas ou laranjas em uma cesta de frutas. Mas não pode misturar colheitas diferentes na mesma cesta.

english: You can buy all the farming tools from farming shops, which can be found close to the allotments.
translation: Você pode comprar todas as ferramentas do agricultor em lojas de agricultura, geralmente encontradas próximas de canteiros de lotes.

english: You can fill plantpots with soil from any empty patch, if you have a gardening trowel.
translation: Você pode encher vasos com terra em qualquer canteiro vazio, se tiver uma pazinha de jardinagem.

english: Tree seeds must be grown in a plantpot of soil into a sapling, and then transferred to a tree patch to continue growing to adulthood.
translation: Três sementes devem ser colocadas em um vaso de planta (com terra) para que possa crescer em uma muda. Depois, transfira o vaso para um canteiro de árvore para que a muda se desenvolva até a fase adulta.

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Se você quiser tecer seus próprios sacos e cestas, você precisará usar o tear localizado próximo à loja do agricultor em Falador.

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough [craftswoman/craftsman], that is.
translation: Você não precisa comprar todos os vasos de planta, sabia? Você pode moldar vasos em uma roda de cerâmica. Isso se você for um artesão decente.

english: Don't just throw away your weeds after you've raked a patch - put them in a compost bin and make some compost.
translation: Não jogue fora as ervas daninhas que você coletar após limpar um canteiro com o ancinho - coloque-as em uma caixa de adubo para fazer adubo.

english: Applying compost to a patch will not only reduce the chance that your crops will get diseased, but you will also grow more crops to harvest.
translation: Jogar adubo em uma plantação não apenas reduz as chances dela ficar doente, como também aumenta a quantidade de colheita delas.

english: Supercompost is far better than normal compost, but more expensive to make. You need to rot the right type of item; show me an item, and I'll tell you if it's super- compostable or not.
translation: Super adubo é muito melhor do que adubo normal, mas é mais caro para produzir. Você precisa adicionar o produto certo na caixa de adubo para apodrecer.

english: Vegetables, hops and flowers need constant watering - if you ignore my advice, you will sooner or later find yourself in possession of a dead farming patch.
translation: Legumes, lúpulos e flores exigem rega frequente - se você ignorar meus conselhos, logo vai descobrir algum canteiro desses tipos mortos.

english: The only way to cure a bush or tree of disease is to prune away the diseased leaves with a pair of secateurs. For all other crops I would just apply some plant-cure.
translation: A única forma de curar um arbusto ou árvore que esteja doente é ao fazer uma poda das folhas doentes, usando tesouras de poda (podadeira). Para os demais tipos de plantações, use poções de cura de planta.

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Oswallt's area
