So? They talk too much.
Why bother? None of them can fight back, after all.
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Old hag indeed! I have a name you know!
Oh, it's actually Alisha, but they let me move in anyway. Not many hags about these days, and beggars can't be choosers!
Only if I can call you Betty!
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
Hello. What can I do for you?
Well, that depends.
It depends on whether you like kebabs or not.
Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry, I mainly help people in need of a kebab.

I offer two different types of kebabs: the standard run- of-the-mill kebab seen throughout Gielinor and enjoyed by many an intoxicated dwarf, and my speciality, the extra-hot kebab. So which shall it be?
That will be three gold coins.
Here you go.
No thanks, I'm good.
Come back soon, I could do with a few more customers.
Is there anything else I can do for you?
One super kebab coming up! Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
Well, that depends. What do you intend to do with it?
But then what do you want it for?
You're not going to put it in Drunken Ali's drink, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
Just be careful with it, it's potent enough to give a camel the runs.

If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab construction is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me my competitive edge and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, I'd
soon be out of business.
Shh! Keep your voice down. You should have told me you were from the union.

If information is what you need, there are many better people to ask than myself who could help you. One of the town's street urchins or perhaps the local drunk. I may be many things to many different people, but a
gossip I am not.
Ah! Here you go!
I need you to answer this for me.
Ali the Kebab seller has given you a challenge scroll!
Please give me your answer!
Nope, not correct!
Spot on!
Ali the Kebab seller has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
I want a standard kebab, please.
Yes, actually.
Could I have an extra-hot kebab please?
Would you sell me that bottle of special kebab sauce?
What is the difference between the standard and the extra-hot kebab?
I want a kebab, please.
Listen I've got to run. I'll catch you later.
I need some information.
I don't have time to talk right now! Ali Morrisane is paying me to hand out these flyers.
Ali Morrisane is the greatest merchant in the east!
Of course I was! You can find him on the north edge of town.
Well, Ali Morrisane isn't too popular with the other traders in Al Kharid, mainly because he's from Pollnivneach and they feel he has no business trading in their town.
I think they're just sour because he's better at making money than them.
The flyer advertises the different shops you can find in Al Kharid.
It also entitles you to money off your next purchase in any of the shops listed on it. It's Ali's way of getting on the good side of the traders.
Here! Take one and let me get back to work.
I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if my boss would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? Look at the flyer you already have!
I'd give you a flyer but it looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
I'm very busy, so listen carefully! I shall say this only once.
Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Emir's Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
If you're here to make money, there is a mine to the south.
Watch out for scorpions though, they'll take a pop at you if you go too near them. To avoid them just follow the western fence as you travel south.
If you're in the mood for a little rest and relaxation, there are a couple of nice fishing spots south of the town.
Then why would I want it? Keep moving, I have to hand all these flyers out before I get paid.
Ali's Discount Wares...
The finest store in the world!
Dommik's crafting store...
The place for all your crafting needs.
Ellis' Tannery...
The prices are better than the smell!
Run your enemies through in style...
with a Scimitar from Zeke's Superior Scimitars!
Visit Louie's Armoured Legs Bazaar...
Number one for clanky trousers!
Visit Ranael's Super Skirt Store ..
for the most stylish protection money can buy!
Keep west as you travel south ...
to avoid the killer scorpions!
Who is Ali Morrisane?
What are the flyers for?
What is there to do round here, boy?
Welcome, adventurer, to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
All are welcome here. Now more than ever I suppose.
There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result. Things are looking dire.
What do you want?
What do you want to know?
That information is available on a need to know basis and right now, you don't need to know.
Can I help you with anything else?
Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on. I shouldn't be telling you that. Just forget I said anything.
You will have to be a lot more specific if you want help finding him. Everyone here is called Ali.
Say no more. I too am looking for him. The little tyke robbed me too, if we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
Tell me about yourself.
Yes I'd like to ask you about something else.
No thanks.
Tell me about the other people in the town.
I'm looking for Ali.
You seem rather cheerful. Is there anything you're after?
Well, it's hot and full of sand.
Don't ask me, I'm not from around here.
A town to the south of the Shantay Pass, called Pollnivneach.
Not very much, at the moment. I came from further south to set up a smithy here...
...but we still haven't set up the shops, so we have no customers yet.
Yes, he's the one who persuaded us to come here.
He said we'd have lots of customers once we set up our shops, and all he asks for is a cut of the profits.
Of course. He's always happy to talk to possible business partners.
What? Who's spreading that rumour?
Don't pay any attention to those people.
They're just worried that they'll lose money when we open our shops.
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
The snake charmer is focusing intently on his music and doesn't seem to notice you.
The snake charmer snaps out of his trance and directs his full attention to you.
If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will happily give you my snake charming super starter kit, complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you are, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
Ah, I see you've lost your snake charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... er, I mean, crowd.
If you're that desperate to try, have my patented snake charming starter kit. It comes with a special snake charming flute and a basket to keep your charmed snakes in. Now, leave me alone!
The snake charmer gives you a snake charming flute and a basket.
I'm not stopping you! You have your own snake charming flute.
What do you need?
There you go. Now if you don't mind I'm busy trying to charm this here snake.
Yes?
No, I doubt it. I believe your talents lie in other areas.
Wow, a snake charmer! Can I have a go? Can I have a go? Please?
I want to talk to you about animal charming.
I'm a little busy at the moment. What is it?
Oh, it has wonderful weather.
Not quite as hot as back home.
Oh, it's a town to the south of the pass, called Pollnivneach.
If I had cloth, patterns and customers, I'd be a tailor. As it is, I'm a tailor with nothing to do.
The silk merchant won't even sell me any silks, because he doesn't trust me!
No, no, it's all being dealt with.
Of course, he's the one who's going to obtain cloth and clothes patterns so I can set up shop here.
And in such a good location, too. Not out of the way like back home.
The customers will soon pour in!
Why not? He's always happy to talk to potential business partners.
Me, threaten people?
Oh, them. Don't mind them. I think they're worried about what effect our shops will have.
For all they know, when we open our shops their wares will look cheap and shabby by comparison!
What can you tell me about Al Kharid?
So, what do you do here?
I hear you work for Ali Morrisane...
I hear you've been threatening the other shopkeepers.
Welcome! I'm Ali, and this is my tea shop! Is there anything I can do for you today?
Of course! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
Oh! Yes, the water is boiling. Just give me a minute!
I know, the desert is forever hot. Thirsty work here!
Hmm...
It's not that. It's just that I've been having issues with a few thieves lately. Four to be precise!
There have been a few break-ins. A recent shipment from Karamja has been taken! That was some of the finest stuff I've ever managed to get my hands on.
Ha! Very courageous, adventurer! These thieves are big and brutish. I wouldn't start something you may not be able to finish.
If you say so.
You're leaving? But the tea is almost done!
Ah yes! I'll get the water boiling at once. Is there anything else I can do for you while you wait?
How's the tea coming along?
How's business here? Seems quite out the way.
I'd best be heading off.
Hello. How can I help you?
Yes - ask a gardener.
What are you selling?
Can you give me any Farming advice?
I'm okay, thank you.
The camel didn't seem to appreciate that question.
Are you serious?
Well, just you close your eyes first. I'm not doing it while you're watching me!
I hope that's what you wanted!
What did you say?
Well, don't interrupt me, I've got work to do.
I'm participating in the construction of a shopping and sales extravaganza!
My masters have me hauling boxes around. There's not much to do at the moment, though.
Yes, that's them. They're traders working for Ali Morrisane.
It's hard work sometimes, but it could be worse.
I heard about a pair of camels back in Pollnivneach who were poisoned!
They say someone put spicy sauce in their food.
I sincerely hope whoever did it was punished. Do they have no compassion for camels?
Ask the camel about its dung.
Say something unpleasant.
Neither - I'm a polite person.
It's that fountain thingy in the temple to the east. It's turned them all into zombies.
None at all, mate, except that those worshippers at that temple keep comin' and killin' 'em all for their bones. Don't ask me why.

I don't know nuthin' about nuthin'. Oim a simple ghost with simple needs. All I know is, years ago, that temple started glowing green and, a few months later, I woke up dead. That's all there is to it.
Good day to you too, Blockhead.
Now what do you want from the old hag of Pollnivneach? Hexes? Curses? Eternal youth? Poisons? You name it, I can brew it.
I'm busy brewing potions, so if you disturb me again without reason, I will turn you into a frog!
Death to the Dorgeshuun!
Greetings and welcome to my farming equipment shop. Would you like to buy some equipment?
Yes, please.
No, thank you.
Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change. Are you busy? I have a problem.
It's my son Hudon, he's always getting into trouble. The boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
Would you? You are kind. You can use the small raft out back if you wish, do be careful, the current down stream is very strong.
Oh okay, never mind.
Hello adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.
Well hello, you're still around then.
Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.
Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?
Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?
Well I'm glad to hear itThe authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
Good for all of us!
Hello adventurer, how's your treasure hunt going?
No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not to crash it this time!
Yes.
No.
You have crossed my path too many times intruder. Leave or face my wrath.
Welcome, adventurer. Know that as a friend to Hazeel, you are always welcome here.
Oh, hello there.
translation: Ah, olá para você.

english: Not too bad... I've just got some troubles on my mind...
translation: Estou bem... Só pensando em alguns problemas...

english: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
translation: Sim, ele me disse. Eu comecei a tecer sua máscara de gás especial, mas preciso de damoras para terminá-la.

english: The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.
translation: Elas crescem no bosque de McGrubor, logo a oeste da Aldeia dos Videntes.

english: There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
translation: Muito bem, aqui está. Enquanto estiver em Ardougne Ocidental, você deve usá-la o tempo todo, ou você pode contrair a Praga.

english: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.
translation: Eu vou fazer uma máscara reserva caso você perca essa que lhe dei. Esconderei em um armário caso os Lamentadores venham averiguar.

english: Alright, I'll go and see him now.
translation: Tudo bem, irei vê-lo agora.

english: Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?
translation: Olá querido, como está indo com o túnel?

english: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.
translation: Bem, tenho certeza que você é mais rápido que Edmond.

english: How's the tunnel going?
translation: Como está indo com o túnel?

english: One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
translation: Um lamentador está passando por aqui perguntando sobre você e Edmond. Fique de olhos bem abertos com ele.

english: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.
translation: E também, não esqueça daquela máscara de gás se você precisar. Está escondida no armário.

english: Hello, any word on Elena?
translation: Olá, alguma notícia de Elena?

english: Is there anything else I can do to help?
translation: Tem mais alguma coisa que eu possa ajudar?

english: That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.
translation: Esse é o espírito, querido. Não esqueça que há uma máscara de gás no armário se você precisar.

english: That's the spirit, dear.
translation: Esse é o espírito, querido.

english: Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: Sim. Deve haver um em algum lugar aqui em casa. Fale comigo se precisar de mais alguma coisa.

english: Thank you for rescuing my daughter! Elena has told me of your bravery in entering a house that could have been plague infected. I can't thank you enough!
Thank you so much for helping Elena. It means so much to Edmond and I.
Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. Here you go.
I need another tabard.
It's not a problem.
They've taken her...
Elena! They came and took her away!
I'm not sure... Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
Good day.
Good day, Your Royal Highness.
Oi!
Rahr!
No!
Grr!
Aargh!
I'm a gonner!
It's no use, I'm done for!
Uggh!
What brings you to these parts, stranger?
I suppose it is a little different to the places your type are used to...
This is my humble little hideaway! Plenty of fish around to sustain a man like me, with the help of my trusty cormorant.
Sure she does! I haven't used a rod in years, just send her out to the waters and she takes care of it for me!
I don't know, I doubt that your type's up to the task...
But it would be quite the amusing sight. Go on!
I'll keep an eye on you and make sure you don't have too much trouble with her!
You're going to need to free up your hands first, though. Nothing in or on your hands.
No surprises there! Your type never have been cut out for it.
Oh, this? This is my trusty old fish sack!
Yeah, fish sack! I might sell you one if you've found any of those pearls around here.
Now that is a biggun! How she managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
If you don't want it, I could take it off your hands for a few of those pearls!
I'll give you a hundred pearls for it. What do you say?
As you wish.
Pleasure doing business with you!
Well, let me know if you change your mind.
Ah, it's you. How are you finding things?
Yes, your type do often seem to underestimate it! Are you finished?
Just come back and let me know when you get tired!
What is this place?
Could I have a go with your bird?
I don't think that's for me.
What's in the sack?
Let's take a look.
No thanks.
I found this big fish...
It's a deal.
No, keep the tench.
Yes, exchange the golden tench.
Not yet. I think I'll keep trying.
Yeah, I'll try again another time.
He seems to be in deep concentration.
Well hello there. Are you hungry? If so you've come to the right place. Eat green, eat gnome cuisine. My waiter will be glad to take your order.
On the other hand, if you're looking for some gnome cooking training, this is also the place to be. My son Lufty is looking for staff at the moment.
In that case, please eat and enjoy.
Well that's great. I'm Aluft Gianne, owner of this restaurant, and you are...?
Really? Sorry, how rude of me. It just takes a little while to get used to the funny names you humans have.
Of course if you're going to work for me I'll have to see what you're like first. Here, take a look at our menu.
Aluft hands you a cook book.
When you've had a look at the book, come back here and I'll let you prepare a few dishes.
Hello [player name]. So what did you think of the book?
They're a gnome delicacy, very tasty. Chicken tastes like toad's legs you know. You'll love them. If I give you what you need, can you make me some Toad Crunchies?
Aluft gives you two pairs of toad's legs, some gnome spice, some equa leaves, some dough and a crunchy tray.
The dough is made according to a secret family recipe. If you need any more, I suggest you speak to Hudo the grocer. He's very reliable.
Let me know how you get on.
So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
That looks identical to the crunchies I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
Ok, let me know when you have.
Ok, I'll give you another one. Obviously I can't expect you to cook without the proper utensils.
Ok, well let me know when you're done.
Call me Aluft. So how did you get on with the toad crunchies?
You give Aluft the toad crunchies. He takes a bite...
Not bad, not bad at all.

Ok, now for something you might prefer. Try making some chocolate chip crunchies for me. They're my favourite. Here's everything you need. You can re-use the spice from the last recipe - one tin goes a long way.
Aluft gives you two bars of chocolate, some chocolate dust, and some dough.
Hello there, how did you get on.
It's one trayful of chocolate chip crunchies that I need. Just follow the instructions carefully.
You give Aluft the chocolate crunchies. He takes a bite...
Yes, yes, yes, that's superb. I'm really impressed.
Ok then, can you make me a toad batta? Here's what you need.
Aluft gives you some cheese, some dough, some equa leaves, a pair of toad's legs and some more gnome spice.
Let me know when the batta is ready.
Aluft.
So where's my toad batta?
That looks identical to the toad batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
I'm afraid I've lost the batta tin you gave to me.
Ok, be as quick as you can.
You give Aluft the toad batta. He takes a bite...
Ooh, that's some good toad. Very nice.
Let's see if you can make a cheese and tomato batta next.
Hello [player name] have you made my Cheese and tomato Batta?
That looks identical to the cheese and tomato batta I cooked not five minutes ago. You'll have to prove to me that you can make one yourself if you want my recommendation.
You give Aluft the batta. He sniffs it then takes a bite...
Hmm, that's actually really good.
How about this? Hmmm. I think you may well be ready for real cooking. Well I'm happy to give you my recommendation to Jnr, if that's what you want.
Well your training with me is over [player name]. Are you interested in some work?

I think you're almost ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There's good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods -
though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...

However, some of the orders Aluft aloft gets are for gnome cocktails, so if you want to work for Lufty, you'll need to undergo some basic cocktail making training. Go and have a chat with him. He's not that
scary...
Oh, one last thing. My special dough, can be occasionally tricky to get hold of. I wouldn't want to stop you from cooking gnome delicacies for want of dough!
Aluft Gianne gives you a voucher for 100 balls of Gianne Dough.
That should last you for a small while eh? That's all the free dough I'm going to give you so don't waste it!

Blurberry tells me that you have finished training with him, so I think you're ready to do some work for my son Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of our new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery. There's good
tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may have to travel all over Gielinor to fulfil some of the other orders...
Go and have a chat with my son Lufty Jnr. and he'll fill you in with details.
No thanks, I'm no cook.
Ok, I'll give it a go.
I'm afraid I've lost the crunchy tray you gave to me.
I've not finished yet.
Good day, [sir/madam].
I'm waiting for my shift. I'm supposed to be digging once the others have finished.
I don't like the sound of these monsters, though.
I heard that Donal went exploring in the caves, and saw a huge monster.
If you want to know more about it, ask Thorodin - he's working on the excavation right now.
I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
I've found that we have some mythology in common.
What are you doing down here?
Good day.
Good day, sir.
I'm waiting for my shift, of course. We can't dig all the time, you know.
I'm also researching the links between the Fremenniks and the Dwarves.
I've found that we have some mythology in common.
Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
Where would you like it moved to?
Your house is already there!
Hmph. Come back when you have 5,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rimmington.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 10.
Your house has been moved to Taverley.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 20.
Hmph. Come back when you have 7,500 coins.
Your house has been moved to Pollnivneach.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 25.
Hmph. Come back when you have 8,750 coins.
Absolutely. Hand me your blueprints and I'll make it happen! I'll keep the blueprints, so you'll always be able to switch back to this style in future, for a small fee.
Your house has been moved to Hosidius.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 30.
Hmph. Come back when you have 10,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Rellekka.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 40.
Hmph. Come back when you have 15,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Brimhaven.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 50.
Hmph. Come back when you have 25,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Yanille.
Where? Never heard of it.
I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to move there. You need to have level 70.
Hmph. Come back when you have 50,000 coins.
Your house has been moved to Prifddinas.
Certainly. My magic can rebuild the house in a completely new style! What style would you like?
Basic wood
Your house is already in that style!
Your house has been redecorated.
I'm afraid you haven't unlocked that style.
Hmph. Come back when you have 35,000 coins.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that.
I'm afraid I'd need some blueprints for that. Maybe you can buy some by working for the contractors.
You've already got one!
Not until you free up some inventory space.
Certainly.
It all came out of the wizards' experiments. They found a way to fold space, so that they could pack many acres of land into an area only a foot across.
They created several folded-space regions across Gielinor. Each one contains hundreds of small plots where people can build houses.
Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they hired me to sell the houses.
There are various other people across Gielinor who can help you furnish your house.
You should start by buying planks from a sawmill operator. Sawmills are located in north-east Varrock, the Woodcutting Guild located in south-west Hosidius and north-east Prifddinas.

As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilities I wear this Skillcape of Construction.
If you ever have enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
The Cape of Construction also provides you with as many teleports as you like to any of the house portals or even directly inside!
Alright, that'll be 99000 coins, please. A small price to pay for such an illustrious cape that can teleport you to any of the house portals or even directly inside your house!
Suit yourself. There are many other heroes who would love the opportunity to purchase one. You can find me here if you change your mind.
Well, come back and see me when you do.

Unfortunately all Skillcapes are only available with a free hood, it's part of a skill promotion deal; buy one get one free, you know. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
Excellent! Wear that cape with pride my friend.
Can you move my house please?
Rimmington
Taverley
Pollnivneach
Hosidius
Yes
No
Rellekka
Brimhaven
Yanille
Prifddinas
Can you redecorate my house please?
Basic stone
Whitewashed stone
Fremennik-style wood
Tropical wood
Fancy stone
Deathly mansion
Twisted theme
Hosidius house
Cosy cabin
Cancel
Could I have a Construction guide book?
Tell me about houses!
Tell me about that skillcape you're wearing.
Can you sell me a Skillcape of Construction?
I'm not paying that!
Certainly, that sounds fair.
Hello, if you've something important to tell me, be out with it! I'm a busy woman.
How very nice of you. However, I'm sure there are less busy people who'd love to chat.
Chin up love and go adventure, that's what you lot do right?
I'm Alyssa the housekeeper and this castle needs constant attention! I've enough trouble with the guards messing up my carpets without you adding to the problem.
It's cut to fit! If I had a gold piece for everytime I was asked that question!
Alright, believe what you like. I've a castle to clean.

A corporeal body is a mere flesh-temple in which the soul dwells. As the body fails, the soul loses its home. Without guidance, it would drift into oblivion.

The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world as you see it, but the three-headed Guardian keeps them safe.
The souls are the dead of Kourend - ensure you respect the souls.
I am here to salute the dead of Kourend whose souls are joining the River. Ensure you respect the souls.
Let me guess, traveller... did you come to ask me where the soul bearer was buried? Every mortal who reads my book seems to want to get their hands on it.

It occurs to me, though, that even if you dig it up, the artefact is damaged. Although the Elders of Arceuus never had the knowledge to repair it, there is one who may be able to help.
I speak of the Key Master, he who watches over the cave of the three-headed Guardian of the River. He has been there for countless years, and will have absorbed power from the River in that time.

Now, we buried the artefact in the crypt of the Arceuus church. As I have revealed this secret to you, you will no longer be affected by the spells that prevent unwary explorers from stumbling across it.

english: Cross my palm with silver and the future will be revealed to you.
translation: Cruze minhas mãos com prata e o futuro será revelado a você.

english: Come closer, and listen carefully to what the future holds for you, as I peer into the swirling mists of the crystal ball.
translation: Chegue mais perto, e ouça com atenção o que o futuro lhe reserva, conforme eu olho a névoa voando em minha esfera de cristal.

english: I can see images forming. I can see you.
translation: Eu vejo imagens se formando. Eu lhe vejo.

english: You are holding a very impressive looking sword. I'm sure I recognise that sword...
translation: Você está empunhando uma espada majestosa. Tenho certeza que reconheço esta espada...

english: There is a big dark shadow appearing now.
translation: Há uma sombra escurecendo tudo ao redor.

english: Aaargh!
translation: Aaargh!

english: It's Delrith! Delrith is coming!
translation: É Delrith! Delrith está vindo!

english: Delrith...
translation: Delrith...

english: Delrith is a powerful demon.
translation: Delrith é um demônio poderoso.

english: Oh! I really hope he didn't see me looking at him through my crystal ball!
translation: Oh! Torço para que ele não tenha me visto o observando pela minha esfera de cristal.

english: He tried to destroy this city 150 years ago. He was stopped just in time by the great hero Wally.
translation: Ele tentou destruir esta cidade há 150 anos. Seus planos foram interrompidos pelo grande herói Wally.

english: Using his magic sword Silverlight, Wally managed to trap the demon in the stone circle just south of this city.
translation: Usando sua espada mágica Clarão Prateado, Wally conseguiu aprisionar o demônio no círculo de pedras logo ao sul desta cidade.

english: Ye gods! Silverlight was the sword you were holding in my vision! You are the one destined to stop the demon this time.
translation: Pelos Deuses! A Clarão Prateado era a espada que você estava empunhando na minha visão! Você é o pré-destinado para neutralizar o demônio dessa vez!

english: If you face Delrith while he is still weak from being summoned, and use the correct weapon, you will not find the task too arduous.
translation: Se você enfrentá-lo quando ele estiver fraco devido à invocação recente, e usar a arma correta, pode ser que essa tarefa não seja tão ardilosa.

english: Do not fear. If you follow the path of the great hero Wally, then you are sure to defeat the demon.
translation: Não tenha medo. Se você seguir os passos do grande herói Wally, garanto que irá derrotar o demônio.

english: Ah, the overconfidence of the young!
translation: Ah, a super confiança dos jovens!

english: Delrith can't be harmed by ordinary weapons. You must face him using the same weapon that Wally used.
translation: Delrith não pode ser ferido por armas comuns. Você deve enfrentá-lo com a mesma arma que Wally usou.

english: Yes I know. Maybe that is why history doesn't remember him. However he was a very great hero.
translation: Sim eu sei. Talvez seja por isso que a história não lembre dele. Mas ele foi sim um grande herói.

english: Who knows how much pain and suffering Delrith would have brought forth without Wally to stop him!
translation: Quem sabe o tanto de dor e sofrimento que Delrith teria trazido se Wally não o tivesse derrotado.

english: It looks like you are going to need to perform similar heroics.
translation: Parece que você precisará de uma bravura parecida a de Wally.

english: Wally managed to arrive at the stone circle just as Delrith was summoned by a cult of chaos druids...
translation: Wally conseguiu chegar ao círculo de pedra logo após Delrith ter sido invocado por um culto de magos negros.

english: A cutscene showing Wally defeating Delrith
translation: Uma cena mostrando Wally derrotando Delrith

english: Cutscene over
translation: Cena acaba

Good day, [madam/sir]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
I am a librarian from the great library of Menaphos. I left to travel the desert and learn more of its history.
Enakhra? I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, and she apparently built a great temple in his honour somewhere in the desert.
However, it is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods.
That is the last anyone knows of what happened to her, and it took place several thousand years ago.
An interesting choice of topic. Akthanakos is a Mahjarrat who was apparently worshipped as a god for a while in these parts. That was a long time ago, of course.
Unlike many of his kin, he was against Zamorak's rise to power. Perhaps that's why he ended up out here. Zamorak has little sway in the desert.
Whatever his reasons, he clearly took a liking to living here. He took on the head of a camel and even made an amulet that would allow him to understand their kind.
Using it, he even trained some of the native camels to fight for him. Their name, 'Ugthanki', is derived from his.
Since he disappeared, however, it is said that the Ugthanki became more violent and started attacking travellers.
Good day, [sir/madam]. Are you interested in the history of this area?
It's good to meet someone so eager to learn.
Now, what would you like to hear about?
I have read only a little about her. She was one of the Mahjarrat who arrived in Gielinor many thousands of years ago.
She supported Zamorak when he tried to gain power, but her attempts to gain his favour failed, and she retreated to a temple she had built.
Like Enakhra, his rival, Akthanakos came to Gielinor with the other Mahjarrat. He took on the aspect of one of the local gods, and is usually drawn with a camel's head.
He was against Zamorak's rise to power, but the last anyone knows of him was that he and Enakhra were thinking of forgetting their rivalry.
Well, my sources say that Enakhra tried to gain favour with Zamorak by building him a temple somewhere in the desert.
It is said that when she showed it to him, he was not impressed, and told her that he would rather have a weapon that could slay gods than a temple.
After that, it seems that Enakhra retreated to that temple. If she hasn't died, she's been there ever since.
I'm afraid I've only heard rumours of it, but here's what I know.
When Akthanakos came to Gielinor and took on the aspect of a man with a camel's head, he made an amulet that would allow him to understand camels.
Because those who cannot remember the past are condemned to repeat it.
Knowing something about history can prevent you from making mistakes that people have made before, you see.

Beginner clues are the lowest tier of clue scroll and as such only require a couple of steps to solve.
Beginner clues are gained through various activities. Those activities are as follows.
Slaying monsters for a chance at a clue being dropped. I hear goblins are sneaky, maybe they have some clue scrolls on them ripe for the taking.
Maybe someone left one in the cow field, who knows where you could obtain them.
Beginner clues have also been known to be left in geodes while mining, as well as sometimes in bottles that you may fish up from time to time and from nests which fall out of trees.
Although this is a much rarer occurrence.
Unlike more advanced clues, you should not expect to get very valuable items from completing a beginner clue.
Advanced clues have tiers between easy and master.
You can gain advanced clues the same way you would get a beginner clue. But to get higher tier scrolls you will need to defeat more powerful foes.

The chance to get a higher tier clue from geodes, bottles and nests is lower the higher the tier. But if you chop down higher-level trees you will have a higher chance of receiving a nest which contains a clue. Same with fishing and mining.
The only exception to this is master clue scrolls.
Master clues can only be obtained as a rare chance when opening your casket or by handing in one of every type of clue, apart from beginner, to Watson who resides in Hosidius.
But with more advanced tiers of clue, come better loot.
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to.
You will see a couple of words that may or may not make sense together. You will have to rearrange the letter to make the name of the person you need to talk to.
This type of clue has you work out a logical problem for the person you need to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
There are also challenges that will involve you gathering an item or crafting an item for a certain person.
This type of clue has you talk to someone around Gielinor. Although the clue does not tell you exactly who to talk to. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium, hard and elite.
A cipher is a string of letters that have been scrambled using the shift cipher method.
An example of this would be ZCZL which, shifted forward by one, would be Adam.
This type of clue will have you use a sextant, chart and a watch to find out the place you will need to dig. This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
After you find the place you need to dig, you may find a casket or another scroll.
This type of clue can be as simple as talk to the specified person or searching a crate in a specified location.
But the higher the tier of clue, the more steps you will have to do beforehand. An example of this would be needing to find a key before opening a chest.
This type of clue will give you a location that you will need to visit, along with some items you will need.
At this location you will need to perform an emote, as well as wear the items that you had to bring along.
Some clues may have you wear nothing at all.
But please don't do that in public!
This type of challenge only appears in clue tiers medium and above.
Depending on the tier of clue, you will need to obtain a strange device from either Reldo, located in Varrock, or Jorral, located south of Tree Gnome Stronghold.
You will then need to use this device to find the location you will need to dig.
There are many different puzzles that you can come across while doing clues. These range from light boxes to puzzle boxes.
Puzzle boxes are puzzles that will have you complete a slider puzzle that, when complete, will look like an image in game.
Light boxes are a puzzle which contains a 5 by 5 grid of lights with some lights on and some lights off.
The puzzle will have you click the buttons below to turn on or off some of the lights with the end goal being, having all the lights turned on.
This type of clue will show you a map of an area.
This map will show you where you will need to dig, or what you will need to search to get the next clue.
This type of clue will show you which fairy ring code you will need to use to get to the right place to dig.
You will then need to use the numbers to figure our where you will need to dig after arriving to your destination.

Speak to any banker and ask to see your bank account. If you have set a PIN you will be asked for it, then all the belongings you have placed in the bank will appear in the window. To withdraw one item, left-
click on it once.

To withdraw many, right-click on the item and select from the menu. The same for depositing, left-click on the item in your inventory to deposit it in the bank. Right-click on it to deposit many of the same items.

To move things around in your bank: firstly select Swap or Insert as your default moving mode, you can find these buttons on the bank window itself. Then click and drag an item to where you want it to appear.
You may withdraw 'notes' or 'certificates' when the items you are trying to withdraw do not stack in your inventory. This will only work for items which are tradable.

For instance, if you wanted to sell 100 logs to another player, they would not fit in one inventory and you would need to do multiple trades. Instead, click the Note button to do withdraw the logs as 'certs' or 'notes',
then withdraw the items you need.
They look like grey pillars, there's one just over there, near the desk. Bank deposit boxes save so much time. If you're simply wanting to deposit a single item, 'Use' it on the deposit box.
Otherwise, simply click once on the box and it will give you a choice of what to deposit in an interface very similar to the bank itself. Very quick for when you're simply fishing or mining etc.

The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect the items there in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell
no one.
So if someone did manage to get your password they couldn't steal your items if they were in the bank.

You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay. Remember not to set it to anything personal such as
your real life bank PIN or birthday.

The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves. If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to
steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
There will also be a delay in actually setting the PIN to be used, this is so that if your account is stolen and a PIN set, you can cancel it before it comes into use!

Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank. This
can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.

If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button. Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a
few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.

My name is Clerk. I work on gathering people together to form what we call clans.
Ah, clans. Where do I begin? Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
These activities could include improving certain skills, battling the same monsters, or even battling other clans!
Other clans form together because they just enjoy the company of other like-minded people. The clan community can be a great resource if you should ever need help with anything.
You can either form your own clan with your friends, or apply to an already existing clan.
Should you choose to form your own clan you will need four friends to join you, and it is recommended that you have spent a good amount of time in this world first. Leadership is not for everyone.
However, fret not. There are plenty of interesting and exciting clans out there! Check out the clan recruitment board to see which clans are currently accepting applications.
Clans offer you the ability to have an official gathering of friends or like-minded individuals in a hierarchical structure.
In other words, you and your friends get an exclusive chat channel and a Clan Hall, as well as the ability to assign ranks to members.
Ranks can be assigned from custom pre-sets, which then determine what permissions that person has.
For example: One person may have the rank to kick players from the chat, while another has the rank to access the Clan Coffer.
The Clan Coffer is a shared coin store, used by members of the clan. Highly ranked members can assign who has permission to deposit and withdraw coins.

A Clan Hall is a private area only accessible for the people with the permission to enter. High ranked members of the clan can restrict it to only allow certain ranks in, or open it up to even allow guests.
The beauty of it is that you can have both. You can keep your house for private guests and your own personal use, but when you wish to see larger groups then the Clan Hall may be more fitting.
My mission is to administer clans; I help form them and can tell you anything you need to know about them.
Why does anyone go anywhere? As a gatherer of people, I go where people gather. The Grand Exchange is known to be a place where people come together. What better place to bring them even closer?

The clan hub is what I call this area, my little corner of the Grand Exchange. This is where every clan is born, as well as the best place to look for new recruits.

I've got cloaks that let you show your clan's colours, and vexilla to help you recruit more people into your clan, but you don't have space to take any.

Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.

Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.

Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.

The simplest thing to cook is raw meat or fish.
Fish can be caught, speak to the fishing tutor south of here in the swamp. Killing cows or chickens will yield raw meat to cook too.
When you have a full inventory of meat or fish, find a range. Look for this icon on your minimap.
You can use your own fire... but it's not as effective and you'll burn more. To build a fire use a tinderbox on logs.
Once you've found your range, click on it. This will bring up a menu of the food you can cook.

When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank. Look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top. There are numerous banks around the world, all marked with that symbol.
If you're interested in quests, I heard my friend the cook in Lumbridge Castle is in need of a hand. Just talk to him and he'll set you off.
Using a range cuts down the possibility of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
Compare the skills you learn to the effort put into making the food and the health that it heals, find a good combination for you.
As you get better and better you'll find that you can cook better food such as pizza! These are very good for healing you when fighting the big monsters.
Of course, you can try making a curry or baked potato if you feel up to it.
Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, expirement which one works for you.

You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys. Use two buckets of water, two handfuls of barley malt, 4 hops of your choice and a pot of ale yeast, then leave to
ferment for a few days!
Simply turn the tap and let the ale flow into the barrel next to the vat, then use empty beer glasses on the barrel.

Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too! You'll need to churn some butter and cheese. Look for the churn icon on the minimap. There is a churn in the farm building northwest of Lumbridge.
The nearest dairy cow is north of the nearby water mill. Take buckets of milk with you to the churn and use the milk on the churn to make butter or cheese.
Use a pot of flour with a bucket of awter. You will then get an option to make bread dough, pitta bread dough, pastry dough, or pizza dough. Select pizza or pastry dough.
Use the pastry dough with a pie dish then add your filling such as apple or red berries.
Finally cook your pie by using the unbaked pie on a cooking range. Mmmm...pie.
There's pizza too! Find yourself some tomato and cheese, use on the Pizza dough. Cook the pizza on a range then add any other toppings you want, such as anchovies.

Two fighters are placed in a combat arena together, to battle to the death. The survivor wins the Duel.

In ranked fights, the winners gain rank and the losers lose rank. The Arena staff will decide who'll be fighting in each ranked Duel, and send the invitations.

Only the ranked fights offer access to the other rewards of the Arena.

This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels.
Once you've found it, click Sign up to sign up to one, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Duel, whenever one begins.

For an unranked Duel, other people might challenge you while you're wandering around the PvP Arena, so keep an eye out for invitation messages.
Click the Challenge option on other players to challenge them to an unranked Duel, and keep an eye on your chatbox for challenges.

Xeric was a dark mage who ruled Great Kourend for at least ten decades. A time period that is sometimes known as the Age of Strife.
We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the 37th to the 47th decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecessor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
Like Xeric, King Shayzien VII was fascinated with the Dark Altar.
The King was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the King.
It is written that Xeric killed the rulers of Kourend's five cities and claimed the kingdom as his own.
It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life. It's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
King Shayzien VII may have found a way to combine these powers.
Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar, but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
Sadly so, though we're not exactly sure how he did so. Xeric used the citizens of Kourend for many experiments, as well as for his own sadistic pleasures.
We have little written record of the experiments, but we believe they might have led to the creation of the lizardmen.
Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieressuggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
Xeric was undoubtedly powerful, but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
Lizardmen are loyal creatures and would do as he commanded without question. With them at his disposal, the people were powerless to resist his authority.
They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom, as you may have seen.
Fortunately, the Shayzien Army keeps them under control.
Without examining their minds, we will never know for sure. However, we assume Xeric genetically altered them to enforce that their duty is to serve him.

Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne grabbed his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.
Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all around.
Legend has it Byrne then gave a galvanizing speech, standing over the butchered guard with his bloodied pitchfork held aloft in the air, urging the people to fight back.

By enchanting these shapes, you'll be converting them into orbs which you can be placed in the hole in the centre. When you die, you may lose Hitpoints XP, so your Hitpoints level may decrease. I offer an insurance service, preventing your Hitpoints level from falling below a certain level.

I like to think of myself more as an evil and scary sort of genie, who people talk about in hushed and fearful tones.

Lastly, I gather it's normal for powerful terrifying creatures to lurk around in dark caves, so I found this one to lurk in myself, nice isn't it?
Why do I get the sense that I'm not being taken seriously here? Please try to remember I am very dangerous and not to be trifled with.

Let's see... We currently have Herman & Franklin Caranos, Arnold Lydspor, Devin Mendelberg and Ramara du Croissant. And me, of course.

Herman and Franklin are brothers, as you'll know. Herman's always been a fishing nut. Franklin's not all that bothered about fishing, but he does like tinkering with machinery. They're originally from East Ardougne.
Arnold's a bit more of a mystery. We think he might be from one of the barbarian tribes, but he never talks about that. He's always up for a chat, if you can understand his accent.
Devin Mendelberg comes from some town in Morytania - ghastly place! I'm not surprised he moved about as far west as he could go! He helps Franklin with the machinery, among other things.

Ramara's another Ardougnian. Her father's a baker there, but she didn't want to spend her whole life baking and doing his accounts. Also, you probably know what Ardougne's crime rate is like - it can't be easy running
a market stall in that city! I went there once, and some wannabe adventurer started following me around trying to pick my pockets! I kept hitting him, but he kept coming back again and again!
Oh, I used to work with my sister, Emily, in the Rising Sun in Falador, but I wanted an outdoor job. The pay's better out here too, and the work's not too bad.
You can fish! But I'd be very glad if you could go and do something about the skeletal magi in the dormitories. They've kept appearing there ever since the trolls left.
Also, if you're into glassbowing, you'll probably want a bit of seaweed. It catches in our nets all the time, so you'll usually find some in the machinery down by the shore.
Ok, but come and talk to me anytime.
What can you tell me about the people here?
What is there for me to do here?
No thanks, I'm fine.
Christmas is ruined!
If I were as ugly as you I would not dare to show my face in public!
Out of my way, punk.
Hmm... you smell strange...
Like a human!
Leave me alone.
Don't talk to me again if you value your life!
Get lost!

Have you no manners?
I don't have time for this right now.
I have no interest in talking to a pathetic meat bag like yourself.
I bet you have wonderful paws.
A very miserable day, altogether... enjoy it while it lasts.
If you catch anyone promise me you'll share.
I haven't smelt you around here before...
You smell familiar...
Seen any humans around here? I'm v-e-r-y hungry.
You look to me like someone with a healthy taste for blood.
Good day to you, my friend.
Fancy going up to the castle for a bit of a snack?
Give me a moment, I have a bit of someone stuck in my teeth...

The last one was this big!

Adventurers pass through here every week, they never find anything though.

Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.
You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
Gerrant searches around a bit.
Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.

I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.

Did you ever get to talk to those people I told you about?

Good good, See you again.
Indeed I have. They are 100 coins each, do you want one?

Well well! You are good with cats!
Here, I have a little present for you...
Gertrude shows you a small medal
Oh, I do love my precious little kittens! Perhaps you could care for one, some day!
No, me and her aren't friends anymore, she tried to poison my cats.
Do I look like I collect cat hairs? It may collect onto my clothes like no tomorrow, but I don't hoard it.
You take Gertrude's comb.
You already have one of Gertrude's combs, it would be rude to take more.
You run the comb through Gertrude's cardigan.
You find some loose cat hairs, you take them and store them in your pocket.

You already have some cat hair, best leave it there.
Wow, that's very impressive.

Well done.

Good day to you young lady.

Mostly happy, but young people have no respect for their elders, theres too many confusing newfangled magic carpets and snake charmers around these days. I remember when this used to be fields.
Well no admittedly it used to be sand, just like it is now, but let an old man have his grumble.
Can I help you?
This here is the Warrior's Guild, a place where the strong may train. I'm the one who decides if you are allowed in or not.
Yes you are. Welcome to the Warrior's Guild!
You may not enter the Warrior's Guild as you are right now.
While you may consider yourself a warrior, I do not.
Go away and train small one. I do not take bribes.
The Warrior's Guild has a code of honour, a code that I respect. Move along.
Combat Achievements are a set of tasks for all adventurers to try and accomplish. They range from simple missions to kill various creatures, to challenges that will push you to your limits.
The purpose of these tasks is for you to grow and improve, experience all that Gielinor has to offer, and become stronger in the process.
Is this something that sounds interesting to you?
Combat Achievements are broken down into six tiers: Easy, Medium, Hard, Elite, Master and Grandmaster.
Each of these tiers is progressively harder than the last, and to earn any rewards from the latter tiers, the prior tiers must be completed.
To complete a tier you will need to conquer every task within it.
This is the icon for the summary panel. Within it there is a section for Combat Achievements.
Clicking on the section will open the Combat Achievements interface, where you can browse tasks, bosses and rewards.
Some tasks will require numerous criteria to be completed, so make sure you read them carefully.
I'd recommend you go kill some monsters. Come back to me when you've completed a tier or two. I'll reward you for your efforts.
Here you go.
You are handed a torn part of a clue scroll.
Your gear is adequate, I'm impressed.
Hey, I have something for you but you don't have any space for it!
Oh, how have you been getting on?
I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your easy rewards?

There you go. I've provided you with the most basic of our ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining easy clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens from the
Warrior guild and an extra commendation point from each Pest Control game.
I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your medium rewards?

There you go. I've provided you with one of our more modest ancient sword hilts. You'll also have an easier time obtaining medium clues, increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, bonus tokens

from the Warrior guild and two extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Additionally, equipping one of my sword hilts at the Barrows will prevent your prayer points from being drained and
your Dwarf multicannon can hold five extra cannonballs.
I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your hard rewards?

also have to kill fewer God Wars minions to access the generals, get more common ecumenical keys, gain access to our most expensive private God Wars rooms, receive a 50% discount on imbue rewards from the
Nightmare Zone and Soul Wars, and gain three extra commendation points from each Pest Control game. Lastly, your Dwarf multicannon can hold 15 extra cannonballs.
I can see that. Nice job. You'll be expecting your elite rewards?

chance of superior slayer creatures appearing. Plus, you'll have to kill even fewer God Wars minions to access the generals, receive even more common ecumenical keys and access to cheaper private God

Wars rooms. Furthermore, your Dwarf multicannon can hold 30 extra cannonballs and your Bracelets of slaughter or Expeditious bracelets will have a chance to fully recharge instead of breaking! I can also customize
your Slayer helmet for you.

There you go. I've provided you with one of our most prestigious ancient sword hilts, along with my cherished lucky penny! You'll also have increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, including the

deadly TzHaar creatures, and have to kill even fewer God Wars minions to access the generals. Again, you'll get even more common ecumenical keys and access to even cheaper private God Wars rooms. Furthermore,
any Thralls you resurrect will last 50% longer. I can also customize your Slayer helmet even more.
Wait, really?
You have come very far. You have earned these rewards.

There you go. I've provided you with our most prestigious ancient sword hilt. You'll also have increased max quantities offered when given boss Slayer tasks, including the deadly TzHaar creatures, and have to kill

even fewer God Wars minions to access the generals. Plus of course, you'll get even more common ecumenical keys and access to even cheaper private God Wars rooms. Furthermore, any Thralls you resurrect
will last 100% longer. And yes, I can also customize your Slayer helmet even more.
I do wonder what you will do now. Good luck, adventurer.
Ghommal welcome you to Warrior Guild!
You not pass. You too weedy.
Heehee... [he/she] say [he/she] warrior... I not heard that one for... at leas' 5 minutes!
No! You is not a strong warrior, you not enter till you bigger. Ghommal does not take bribes.
Ghommal stick to Warrior's Code of Honour. When you a bigger, stronger warrior, you come back.
Your gear so strong. Me impressed.
What are you doing out here?
I'm here to talk about Combat Achievements.
Could you explain what they are?
Yes, tell me about Combat Achievements.
Not at the moment, no.
I have to go.
No, I'm alright thanks.
I think I've completed a combat tier!
Hello? Perhaps you can understand me? If you can hear me that is?
You can? You can! How wonderful! It has been a long while since anyone came by that could understand what I wanted to say to them. You wouldn't happen to have a moment to help me out would you?
Bernina! I don't think I did mention it. I haven't had to do an introduction for a while now!
It's very unfortunate really. I died.
I was a crew member on board a ship sailing out of Fortis. We got caught in a storm and sailed too close to the rocks around Shipwreck Cove. I'm sure you can guess the results...

The thing is though, after I died, I was not guided to Mictl. I remained, but in this form. I saw the remains of our ship, and I saw some of those salvagers from the east claiming whatever they wanted.
One of them took a diamond necklace from my body. It was very precious to me. It should not remain in the hands of a thief.
Thank you, [player name]. I heard the one that took it being called Jasper by one of his fellow salvagers. He is the one you will need to find.
Hello again, [player name]. Have you got any leads on my necklace yet?
Oh no. I'd hoped he wouldn't sell it on so quickly. Maybe there's still hope though. Any mountain climber around here will surely be heading up the Proudspire...
I actually did the climb myself once. I promised my son we'd go up there again together, but we never found the time...
You did? Were you able to get it back?
Are you sure?
Alright then. I'll meet you up there.
Bernina heads up the mountain.
He can't understand me. Please, [player name], tell him who I am.
Tell him I'm proud of him, and... tell him I'm sorry I never came home.
I think I know now... I know why I stayed behind. It was for this. Thank you, [player name]. I think it's time for me to go now. Tell Bernard I will always be with him...
Bernina fades away.
We are waiting for you to join us.
Woooo... Woooooo...
You see me? You understand me?
Me Hopespear of Narogoshuun tribe. Who you?
You not goblin. What you want here?
Me dead, but me not go. Long ago, me have vision of Big High War God. Me chosen prophet of Big High War God.
Me think, when me die, Big High War God take me to reward in Yu'biusk. Every day great battle, every night great victory with feasting.
Big High War God not come, but me have faith. Someday Big High War God come for me, take me to him. Until then me hang on, not let go into death.
You go to Yu'biusk? What you see?
Wasteland? No goblins fighting glorious battles?
You lie!
Even so... Yu'biusk is place of Big High War God. Land of Goblins. It where goblins should go.
Will you do me favour?
High priests in this tomb, when they die they believe they go to Yu'biusk. But their spirits still here.
If you can go to Yu'biusk, you can take their bones and bury them there. Will you do this for me?
Thank you!
Normally, undead goblin high priests cannot be destroyed, but there is ancient goblin combat ritual.
You must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells. Once you have bones, take them to Yu'biusk and bury them there.
Thank you, human.
Me should know better than to ask human to do favour for dead goblin.
Thank you! I know Big High War God still care for us! I wait for him here. Someday he take me to Yu'biusk to live with him.
In meantime, will you do me favour?
Big High War God greatest of all gods! He take puny goblins from Yu'biusk and make them mighty warriors for great war of gods!
When gods go to war, goblin soldiers so good that Big High War God sell tribes to fight for different gods. Big High War God fight with other gods, sometimes for one, sometimes another.
Other gods fight for their own reasons, but Big High War God fight for war itself!
Me chosen prophet of Big High War God. Before I have prophecy, goblin tribes fight one another very much.
Long ago we fight other people: beardy-short-people, pointy-hat-short-people, tall people with keen blades. Other people build cities with walls, and we not able to attack them any more.
There not enough food for all tribes, so tribes with no food attack tribes who have food. Goblin war last many many years. Finally all tribes meet at this place, where temple is now.
It rain many days. But rain not stop goblins. Goblin feet churn up ground with rain and goblin blood. All ground turn to mud. That why it called Battle of Plain of Mud.
Battle last many days. Both sides same size, none win, none lose. Goblin bodies everywhere. Many dead.
Me not important general, not mighty sergeant. Me just normal goblin. But one night, me have dream.
Me see throne of Big High War God. He shine with light so bright me cannot see him, but me hear his voice.
He say, 'Stop the fighting!' He say, 'Fighting good, but not if all my followers die! You must not fight one another so much you all die!'
Then he say, 'Today I cannot lead you, but some day I will send Chosen Commander to lead you.'
I see Chosen Commander in dream. He wear shining armour and stand at front of army of goblins. Behind Chosen Commander, goblins stretch to horizon. Many goblins, too many to count.
I see banners of every tribe. Banners of all tribes, even Dorgesh tribe.
Other races, they run away from mighty goblin army! Chosen Commander make goblins build siege machines and they break down walls of cities. Then goblins march in and kill everyone!
And when all dead, Big High War God himself appear and sit on great throne of bronze and rule over all, with Chosen Commander beside him.
Then I wake from dream. I know it true vision from Big High War God. I run to general of my tribe, and he call other generals for emergency meeting.
I tell all generals what I see. They decide to stop fighting so goblins not all die. By this time, so many had died that there enough food for all.
Then generals set goblins to work building temple on site of battle. It sink into mud, so they turn it into underground temple, and keep it secret from others.
Goblins write my vision down in goblin holy book, along with history of goblins and commandments of Big High War God.
Me not know much more. In vision, Chosen Commander wear heavy armour and big helmet that cover face. Me not know what he look like. I see him give orders, but he far away so me not hear his voice.
Me think Chosen Commander will be great goblin general, but Big High War God chose me to have vision, not great general, so Chosen Commander could be anyone.
You take bones to Yu'biusk yet?
You please do this for me, human. Remember, you must defeat high priests without using any weapons, armour or spells.
Thank you. Not many humans like you. Now goblin high priests can rest.
Why are you here?
I visited Yu'biusk.
It was a wasteland.
What favour?
Yes.
I'll do that.
Tell me about the Big High War God.
Tell me more about yourself.
No.
It was everything you hope for.
I should go.
Tell me more about the Chosen Commander.
Nothing. I should go.

Children, run quickly!
Oh my gods, the dragon is coming back!
Quickly, run!
WOOO woooo wooo WOOOO!

On the horizon! Do you see it?
Put that fire out!
Wooo wooo wooOOooOOoo!
Eeeek!
EIEEEEE!
Mummy, are we safe now?
Mummy! Where are you?
Wooo wooo woooooooo!

Oh no!
Someone help me! I'm trapped!
AAARGH!
Come on, you monster! Just finish me!

We're all doomed.
Woooo wooo wooooo woooo

Woooo wooo wooooo woooo.

Did you not hear me? Do I need to spell it out for you?

Useless! Perhaps the headsman needs to take your head as well. I will find the centurion myself!

Is everything all right my friend? You don't seem to be yourself.
Hmm. You're clearly confused. The lack of sleep is getting to you. Go and have a lie down and we will discuss this later.
I've been doing some research into our new foes. Rumour has it they once lived in a great city in the far north. The city fell and now they are homeless.
It seems they have been promised a new home here in return for wiping us out. We must take great care. We may be fighting for our home, but it seems they are as well.
You tell me, I'm no warrior. That said, I did hear that they'd managed to turn some of our own golems against us. If they can do that, I fear what else they may do.

Group Iron Man is a game mode where you do everything as a group. You can only trade items with player's in your group, take their items and accept their help.

Can I help you with anything else?

Group Prestige is lost upon inviting new members into the group, or upon doing certain activities with players outside of your group.
Hardcore Group Iron mode is a more challenging version of the regular mode, in which you have only a set number of lives for the entire group.

Welcome to Hickton's Archery Store. Do you want to see my wares?
Certainly! Skillcapes are a symbol of achievement. Only people who have mastered a skill and reached level 99 can get their hands on them and gain the benefits they carry.
The Cape of Fletching can be searched for a mithril grapple and crossbow three times every day. Is there anything else I can help you with?
I have a question for you.
Hickton has given you a challenge scroll!
Please enter the answer to the question.
No, try again.
Correct!
Hickton has given you [another clue scroll/a casket]!
Can you tell me about your cape?
I'd like to view your store please.
No thank you.
Yes, please.
No, I prefer to bash things close up.
Hey, down there! What is it?
For the dragons, of course! I've always wanted to slay dragons. I've found they're a bit tough, though, even with all this kit I've got, but I'll slay them one day.
My little cousin is a Slayer Master, lucky girl. But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
My little brother became a Slayer Master recently. That job should have been mine - he's just a little brat! But one day I'll be a mighty dragon-slayer, and they'll give me a job like that too.
Yes, certainly, since you've been assigned to do so.
No, you haven't got an assignment to slay these dragons. Go and train somewhere else.
I'm sure that's not what you're meant to be slaying.
Why are you here?
Can I kill the dragons in here?
I'll be off.

Enjoy your stay here. May it be spiritually uplifting!
How kind of you to bring me a message to this remote island!
I don't have much in the way of wealth, but I can spare you a few coins for your trouble.
In the name of Saradomin I shall bless you...
Here, let me give you some herbs.
The beasts which dwell under this island occasionally drop gems when they die - please take this one as a sign of my gratitude.

Hello again. How can I help you?
Things are slowly coming back to life in our city of the dead. The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has been restored, and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
We're making progress on them. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally deal with the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
We worried they'd just come back, but perhaps we have managed to appease whichever god sent them.
The infected cows have been handled as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
They are adamant that their city must remain closed until all the plagues have gone. Until we can get rid of the pox, I can't see their gates opening to us, or to anyone else.
Indeed. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
I'm afraid I only had the one.
Hello again.
Wonderful! The city of the dead has fully come back to life, and it's all thanks to you!
They are continuing their preparations. It will take some time, but the city will soon be open once more.
Certainly, though it will cost you 10,000 coins.
You don't seem to have enough money for it.
Fair enough. Let me know if you change your mind.
Until next time.
Hey, hey, hey! What in the name of sweet suffering Icthlarin are you doing?
All that you'll achieve by pouring that potion on me is to ruin my lovely robes.
Oh? What kind of favour?
Well, like you say, it is not really our way. Still, with all you've done for us, I'm willing to try.
Could I have another lamp?
No. I should get going.
