Greetings, [player name].
Deary deary me...
I'm not giving out free money, but if you try again later I'd be glad to reward you if you'd do a little job for me.
I'm not giving out free money, but I'd be happy to reward you if you'll do a little job for me.
I'm sure I can think of a few little jobs. This won't be a quest, mind you, just a little favour...
You don't appear to have enough space in your inventory. Come back and see me when you do.
Gladly, though they cost 99,000 coins.
All skillcapes come with a hood - you're not going to be able to hold them now. Try again another time.
Thanks, but I don't have anything I need doing right now.
If you'd do a few more quests, you'd soon become a fairly noted adventurer yourself.
Perhaps one day those lost secrets will be uncovered once more.
So I'd heard. Lord Saradomin is smiling on you.
What is this of which you speak?
And what makes you believe in this 'Armadyl'?
So you trusted the word of these people who had been sitting down a hole all their lives?
I wouldn't worry about this sacred 'armadyllo' anymore. Just another foolish myth.
That is an impressive feat, adventurer. Truly you must be beloved in the eyes of Saradomin.
YOU'VE DONE WHAT?
Adventurer, I beg of you, do not meddle in the gods' affairs. No good can come of it.
What names are these?
Adventurer, what folly leads you to think any of these - things, exist?
It is hot in that land, and the heat can affect a traveller in strange ways. Tell me, when you met 'Icthlarin', had you been feeling at all unwell?
So a strange woman interfered with your mind, then you met a man with the head of a jackal, and you decided he must be a god?
Well, make sure you don't get hypnotised again, and I'm sure you'll not meet any more jackal-headed men claiming to be gods!
It'd probably be best if you don't go there again.
Indeed, I have.
I know what I know.
And knowing what I know, I do not speak of this matter. Perhaps you would be wise to heed my example.
Traveller, I beg of you, do not have further dealings with such creatures! You do not know their power as I do.

If you travel to the Mage Arena in the north-west reaches of the Wilderness, the battle mage Kolodion may be willing to let you learn to summon the power of Saradomin, should you be able to pass his test.
I suppose you could use that in combat.
I suppose you could use that for defense.
Runes are very useful things, but I'll take some of those off your hands for you.
Ooh, runes? Yes, they're quite valuable.
That's called 'money'. Money is fantastically important if you haven't got enough of it, but when you've got as much as I have, you realise that money doesn't matter.
That's mine. I'll take it back, thank you very much!
How did you get your hands on that?!
Get out of here this instant.
Tell you what, rather than you showing me items individually, I'll look through all your possessions to see if I can find anything worth discarding.
It'd be politer to come and talk to me before you start messing around with my possessions!
No, no. I'm not planning anything like that again.
Well, this is rather embarrassing, but I think there's some kind of monster in my house. Could you go upstairs and get rid of it, please?
I think it's somewhere upstairs. It kept me awake all last night.
I need some bronze bars. Please bring me [#].
Mine some copper ore and tin ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of bronze.
I need a few bronze daggers to keep the goblins at bay. Please bring me [#].
I'd like some maces made of bronze. Please bring me [#].
I need a few bronze arrowheads to complete some arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
I'd like some bronze knives to throw at goblins. Please bring me [#].
My weapons collection isn't all it used to be. Some short swords made of bronze would be much appreciated. Please bring me [#].
The head fell off my axe when I was chopping wood last week, so I need some more bronze axes. Please bring me [#].
Could you fetch me some big warhammers made of bronze? Please bring me [#].
I could do with some medium-sized helmets. I'd like bronze ones. Please bring me [#].
I need some lengths of bronze wire to repair something. Please bring me [#].
Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [daggers/maces/arrowheads/throwing knives/short swords/axes/warhammers/helmets/wire].
I need some iron bars. Please bring me [#].
Mine some iron ore. The furnace in Lumbridge can smelt them into bars of iron.
I need some iron arrowheads to put on the arrows I was making. Please bring me [#].
I could do with some iron throwing knives to keep the goblins away from my house. Please bring me [#].
I'd like some chunky iron warhammers. Please bring me [#].
Some iron maces would be useful. Please bring me [#].
Try smelting some iron. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make [arrowtips/throwing knives/warhammers/maces].
A few lumps of iron ore would be nice. Please bring me [#].
It should be easy enough for you to mine some iron ore.
I've found a use for cadava berries. Please bring me [#].
Just look around the woods south-west of Varrock.
The hail can be very heavy here, so I'd like a few leather cowls. Please bring me [#].
If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the cowls yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
Strange as it may seem, I want a lot of beer! Please bring me [#].
There's a pub not far from here that will sell you plenty of that. Go west to Port Sarim.
I don't have a decent larder here, so I can't store food very well. Now I'm out of loaves of bread. Please bring me [#].
Mix some flour and water to make bread dough, then bake it on a cooking range.
I'll be needing a few pieces of soft leather. Please bring me [#].
There's a tanner in Al Kharid who will turn cowhides into leather.
I saw an interesting bed in Karamja called a 'hammock'. It seemed to be made out of string, and I'd like some balls of wool so I can make my own. Please bring me [#].
You can buy shears from the general store east of here. Shear some sheep, then spin the wool into balls on the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle.
It's a bit nippy in this house, and my hands are cold. I need some leather gloves. Please bring me [#].
If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to sew the gloves yourself. Buy a needle & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid.
I'm going to make an omelette, so I'll need some eggs. Please bring me [#].
Eggs are usually found where chickens are farmed.
My undergarments are getting a bit worn out. I'll be needing some sheets of silk to patch them. Please bring me [#].
There's a man in Al Kharid who sells it very cheaply. If you ever take any to Ardougne you'll get a good profit.
I'll need some clay that's been softened so I can craft it. Please bring me [#].
If you mine some clay, you can use containers of water on it to soften it.
Believe it or not, I need a few unfired clay pots. Please bring me [#].
Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pots. Just don't bake them.
My roof is leaking, so I need some swamp paste to fix it. Please bring me [#].
Swamp tar is found south-east of here. Add it to a pot of flour and cook it on an open fire to make the paste.
Potatoes
There's a field of those north of Lumbridge.
I want to make some arrows, so I'll need some headless arrows that have the feathers attached. Please bring me [#].
Use a knife to chop some logs into arrowshafts. Then add a feather to each arrowshaft.
I need some bronze spears. Please bring me [#].
If you kill some of those pesky goblins, you're bound to get some bronze spears.
My glassware got damaged when I moved here, so I need some new beer glasses. Please bring me [#].

If you get some seaweed and a bucket of sand, you'll be able to mix them at a furnace to make molten glass. Then use a glassblowing pipe to make beer glasses. Most of what you need can be found on Entrana.
My plans for today require some sets of bones, the normal-sized sort you get from goblins. Please bring me [#].
You'll find bones easily enough if you fight creatures.
Strange as this may seem, I need some unfired pie dishes. Please bring me [#].
Mine some clay. Then use a container full of water to soften it. In the Barbarian Village you'll be able to form this into pie dishes. Just don't bake them.
I hear pet cats are getting popular these days. I'd like some raw rat in case I get one. Please bring me [#].
You should find some big rats south-east of here in the swamp.
I need a few lumps of copper ore. Please bring me [#].
It should be easy enough for you to mine some copper ore.
I'm out of flour, so I could do with a few pots of that. Please bring me [#].
There's a windmill north of here. You can use it to grind grain into flour. Then use an empty pot to collect the flour.
I need a handful of feathers to stick in my beard. Please bring me [#].
The cheapest way to get feathers is to kill chickens.
This house is a bit cold, so I could do with some normal logs to burn. Please bring me [#].
I suggest you take an axe and chop down some standard trees.
I'm running short of food, so I'd like some cooked chickens. Please bring me [#].
You could try killing some chickens, then cooking their meat.
My footwear is getting a bit worn out, so I need a few pairs of leather boots. Please bring me [#].
If you get the tanner in Al Kharid to turn some cowhides into leather, you'll be able to make the boots yourself. Buy needles & thread from the crafting shop in Al Kharid if you need any.
I'd like a few cowhides. Please bring me [#].
If you slaughter some cows, you'll get cowhides easily enough.
My shortbow's string is getting a bit worn out, so could you fetch me some bow strings? Please bring me [#].
If you pick some flax, you can use the spinning wheel in Lumbridge Castle to spin it into bowstrings.
I'm a bit hungry. I'd like some cooked meat, not chicken or any sort of bird. And definitely not camel or rabbit either! Please bring me [#].
Just cook some beef, rat or bear.
I'm short of ammunition, so I could do with some bronze arrows. That way I can shoot at goblins through my window. Please bring me [#].
You can make them by chopping a log into arrowshafts and adding feathers to them, then smithing a bronze bar into arrowheads to complete the arrows.
I'd like a bit of grain. Please bring me [#].
There's a field full of it north of here.
I need a few lumps of tin ore. Please bring me [#].
You shouldn't have any trouble mining tin ore.
I could do with some freshly cooked [anchovies/shrimps] for a salad I'm planning. Please bring me [#].
Use a small fishing net to get [anchovies/shrimps] from the sea south of here. Then cook them on a fire or range.
I'd like to study the rune essence that the wizards have been talking about recently, so I need a few pieces. Please bring me [#].
Ask the Archmage in the tower south of here to teleport you to the Rune Essence mine. Then you can mine me some pieces.
Some chunks of molten glass would be the ideal patch for my cracked window. Please bring me [#].
Use a bucket of sand with some soda ash on a furnace.

Ah, thank you very much! Now I shall be able to sleep in peace.
Allow me to offer you an appropriate reward for your assistance...
Ahh, you are very kind.
Thank you, thank you! In thanks, I shall bestow on you a simple blessing.
Thank you, thank you! Please take this money as a sign of my gratitude.
Thank you, thank you! Please take these seeds as a sign of my gratitude.

Willow trees will yield willow logs. You'll find willows like to grow near water, you can find some south of Draynor.
Maple logs can be gleaned from Maple trees. You'll usually find Maple trees standing alone amongst other trees.
Yew trees are few and far between. We do our best to cultivate them. Look for the tree icon on your minimap to find rare trees. Try North of Port Sarim.
Magic trees are... magic. A difficult wood to work with, but worth it for the rewards. Find them in the areas south of Seers village or on the East side of the Mage Arena.
Hollow trees can be found in the Haunted Woods east of Canifis, but be careful of the leeches.
Bronze axes are easy to get, simply go visit Bob in his shop in Lumbridge, or talk to me if you have mislaid yours.
As you progress in your combat skill you will find you can wield your woodcutting axe as a weapon, it's not very effective, but it frees up a slot for another log.
As your woodcutting skill increases you will find yourself able to use better axes to chop trees faster.... anything up to steel you can buy from Bob's axe shop.
Rune axes can be player made with very high level smithing and mining. They can also be obtained through killing one of the fearsome tree spirits, though this is very rare.
